descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. JOB SUMMARY: The Tendering & Purchasing Specialist is responsible for managing the end‑to‑end tendering, sourcing, and purchasing activities for materials, components, and services used in the manufacture of safety‑related and non‑safety‑related nuclear power plant parts. This role ensures compliance with stringent nuclear quality standards, regulatory requirements, and company procedures while achieving cost, quality, and delivery objectives. The ideal candidate must have the ability to interpret Bills of Materials (BOMs) and technical drawings to accurately estimate costs and prepare proposals. This role requires close collaboration with sales, engineering, procurement, and finance teams to develop winning submissions and support business growth. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: · Prepare and manage RFQs, tenders, and purchase orders · Evaluate supplier offers for commercial, technical, and quality compliance · Negotiate pricing, lead times, and terms · Ensure adherence to nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements · Coordinate with engineering, quality, and production teams · Track orders, expedite deliveries, and resolve supplier issues SECONDARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Keep department manager apprised of future opportunities.
• Advise management of changes in current order and tender status.
• Actively involved with standardization and continuous improvement processes.
• Maintain quote and order files.
• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and QESH Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
• Performs other duties as assigned. EDUCATION, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.
• Minimum 1 year of experience in tendering, purchasing, cost estimation, or bid management in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
• Proficiency in reading and interpreting BOMs and technical drawings.
• Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and cost structures.
• Experience with ERP systems (SAP), SalesForce and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) preferred but not required.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines. What we offer you Country Benefits:
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Environmental, Safety & Health (ESH) Supervisor is responsible for leading safety initiatives, compliance programs, and environmental standards across multiple field service locations. This role provides direct supervision of safety processes, supports environmental compliance, and ensures field crews operate safely and in alignment with regulatory and customer requirements. Partnering with operations, HR, and corporate EHS to drive a proactive safety culture, oversee training and compliance systems, and provide hands-on job site support to protect people, equipment, and the environment. Responsibilities: Leadership & Program Oversight
• Supervise and guide ESH activities across Houston, New Orleans, and field service operations.
• Lead implementation of safety programs, SSE initiatives, and environmental compliance efforts.
• Ensure consistent execution of OSHA, DOT, ISO, and customer safety standards.
• Work with project managers, site supervisors, and contractors to integrate safety into operations and project planning.
• Conduct monthly safety meetings with supervisors and oversee annual safety goal setting, incentive programs, and continuous improvement projects. Environmental Compliance
• Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, permitting, and reporting requirements.
• Oversee hazardous waste management, spill kit inspections, and air/noise/chemical monitoring
• Support facility audits and ensure emergency environmental response plans are in place and tested. Safety Training & Records Management
• Manage new hire safety onboarding and orientation in partnership with HR and Medical.
• Oversee training compliance through TrainingToday, 360Training, and other platforms.
• Ensure OSHA 30, confined space, fall protection, rigging, and site-specific training are current.
• Coordinate external training such as NCCCO, NCCER, CSHO, and Safe Bolting - tracking completion rates against annual targets. Field Safety Leadership
• Conduct site visits for high-risk or large-scale jobs, near misses, or incidents.
• Participate in pre-job planning with operations and supervisors to evaluate scope, risks, and safety requirements.
• Develop, implement, and distribute Safety Execution Plans (SEPs) for each project, tailored to customer requirements and site-specific risks.
• Communicate plans to supervisors, crews, and subcontractors before mobilization.
• Provide onsite support for Daily Safety Meetings/Toolbox Talks, JSAs, WIP reports, PPE checks, inspections, and safety coaching.
• Inspect tool units and field equipment regularly to identify tools or equipment that may have slipped through initial inspections, ensuring unsafe items are removed from service immediately.
• Lead or support incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action tracking.
• Partner with Field Service Supervisors to ensure lockout/tagout (LOTO), lift plans, and job permits meet standards. Express any concern to the Supervisor and plan for any improvements.
• Support medical response and injury management in coordination with Prime GS and external providers. Compliance Systems & Reporting
• Ensure subcontractors and vendors follow site-specific safety plans and meet compliance requirements set by the customer.
• Conduct site audits, verify qualifications, and equipment maintenance/inspection records. (forklift, overhead crane, rigging, etc.).
• Oversee contractor compliance platforms (ISNetworld, Avetta, NCMS, Veriforce).
• Manage OSHA logs, DOT compliance, certificates of insurance, ISO requirements, and EMR reporting.
• Coordinate internal and external audits; oversee documentation and corrective action closeouts.
• Prepare monthly MIS reports, TRIR, injury rates, and observation st

About the role Job Summary The Sr. Machinery Mechanic is responsible for maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and mechanical systems. This role performs complex diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and repairs, ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization. Key
• Responsibilities Inspect, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical equipment. Perform preventive maintenance and document findings. Replace or fabricate parts as needed. Maintain tools and ensure safe working conditions. Collaborate with production teams to minimize downtime. Train and support junior mechanics. Follow safety and operational procedures. Skills &
• Qualifications Typically requires vocational training (or equivalent experience) and several years of relevant work experience to carry out the role. Strong mechanical aptitude and diagnostic skills. Experience with industrial machinery and tools. Ability to read technical manuals and schematics. Knowledge of safety regulations and maintenance procedures. Good communication and teamwork skills. This position requires the ability to perform essential job functions in an shop environment, including prolonged periods of standing, walking, and lifting of up to 25-40 pounds may be required. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment drug screening and, where applicable, ongoing testing in accordance with company policies and legal requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. What we offer you Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Position Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Tendering Engineer to support proposal development for equipment and services supplied to nuclear power plants. The ideal candidate will have 3–5 years of experience working with industrial pumps or strong pump application knowledge, and a solid understanding of tendering processes in highly regulated environments. This role involves preparing competitive, compliant proposals, coordinating across engineering, procurement, and project teams, and ensuring strict adherence to nuclear industry standards and customer specifications. Key Responsibilities
• Review and analyze RFQs and customer specifications related to nuclear pump systems
• Prepare technical proposals for pumps and related parts
• Interpret datasheets, and technical drawings to ensure accurate scope definition
• Collaborate with sales, engineering, purchasing, quality, and project management teams to develop compliant bids
• Conduct cost estimation, including materials, labor, manufacturing, and third-party components
• Ensure compliance with nuclear standards (e.g., ASME, RCC-M, ISO, QA requirements)
• Identify risks and opportunities within tender documents and propose mitigation strategies
• Support post-bid clarification meetings and customer discussions
• Maintain tender documentation, bid logs, and lessons learned
• Contribute to continuous improvement of proposal processes and tools Qualifications & Experience Required:
• 3–5 years of experience in pump systems, rotating equipment, or fluid handling systems
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, a related field, or relative work experience.
• Proven experience in technical tendering, proposals, or applications engineering
• Strong knowledge of Nuclear pumps
• Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, drawings, cross sections, and datasheets Preferred:
• Experience supplying equipment to nuclear, power generation, or highly regulated industries
• Familiarity with nuclear quality standards and documentation requirements
• Exposure to ERP/CRM systems and costing tools such as SAP and Salesforce Technical Skills
• Pump selection, sizing, and application knowledge
• Understanding of materials, hydraulics, and system integration
• Costing and commercial awareness
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Ability to work with technical and commercial documentation
• High attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines. What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving. A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference. We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities
• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes
• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures
• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding
• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers
• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time Job Qualifications
• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)
• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors
• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings
• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Paid overtime opportunities
• Annual companywide bonus
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Der Gruppen-IT-Leiter ist für die Definition und Umsetzung der IT-Strategie für den Konzern verantwortlich, um die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsprioritäten und die langfristigen digitalen Transformationsziele sicherzustellen. Die Rolle leitet mehrere IT-Funktionen, überwacht die Technologie-Governance und gewährleistet eine sichere, skalierbare und moderne Infrastruktur und Systeme, die den globalen Betrieb unterstützen. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Führungskräfte, die sich an der mittel- bis langfristigen (3-5 Jahre) Strategieentwicklung für ihr Unternehmen oder ihren Funktionsbereich beteiligen. Verantwortlich für die Ausführung der Strategie und die operative Leitung eines Unternehmens oder einer Funktion. Arbeitet eng mit der Gruppenleitung in Angelegenheiten von strategischer Bedeutung für die Organisation zusammen. Verwaltet typischerweise mehrere Teams. Als Teil unserer Transformationsreise sucht Sulzer einen strategischen, dynamischen und praxisorientierten IT-Vertriebs- und Marketingführer, der wichtige Initiativen wie die Harmonisierung globaler Vertriebsplattformen vorantreiben wird. Diese Rolle stellt eine wichtige Führungsposition in einem der geschäftskritischsten IT-Bereiche dar, die direkt kommerzielle Exzellenz ermöglicht und das Umsatzwachstum beschleunigt, indem Vertriebsteams mit skalierbaren, datengesteuerten und integrierten Fähigkeiten ausgestattet werden, die auf die Wachstumsambitionen von Sulzer ausgerichtet sind. Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten
• Definieren und vorantreiben Sie die globale Vision und Strategie von IT Sales & Marketing, die auf die kommerziellen Exzellenzprioritäten von Sulzer ausgerichtet ist.
• Liefern Sie gemeinsam mit Ihrem Team einige der wichtigsten IT-Initiativen und Transformationsprogramme, damit unsere Vertriebsteams ihre Wachstumsstrategie umsetzen und die Umsatzgenerierung beschleunigen können.
• Die Konsolidierung, Harmonisierung und Modernisierung der globalen CRM-Landschaft vorantreiben und erfolgreich steuern, einschließlich der vollständigen Migration zu Salesforce, um die Vertriebsqualität und -leistung deutlich zu verbessern.
• Führen Sie die Modernisierung der CPQ-Fähigkeiten an, um Auftragskonvertierungsprozesse zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern, während Sie digitales Marketing und E-Commerce-Plattformen der nächsten Generation nutzen, um neue Einnahmequellen zu erschließen und das Umsatzwachstum nachhaltig zu steigern.
• Partnerschaft mit Sales Leadership, Marketing, Produktmanagement und Divisional b Usiness p Artners, um Roadmaps zu gestalten und die Geschäftsnachfrage zu priorisieren.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Technologielösungen mit der Geschäfts- und Marketingstrategie, den Zielen der Benutzererfahrung und den Datenintegritätsstandards übereinstimmen.
• Förderung der Zusammenarbeit und einer Hochleistungskultur innerhalb des Sales Excellence IT-Teams
• Ich verneint mit Ihren Frameworks die Bereiche für Verbesserung, Konsolidierung und Standardisierung.
• Entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team: L ead, Mentor und entwickeln Sie ein funktionsübergreifendes, multikulturelles Team von > 10 IT-Experten in mehreren Regionen, um eine erfolgreiche Implementierung und den Lebenszyklus von Vertriebsanwendungen sicherzustellen.
• Verwalten Sie externe Anbieter und Systemintegratoren, um Projekte und Support-Services gemäß den Budget- und Qualitätserwartungen bereitzustellen.
• Eigene und Weiterentwicklung der globalen Sales IT-Applikationslandschaft von Sulzer, einschließlich Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, CPQ-Tools (Configure-Price-Quote) und Engineering-Design-Tools für Produktauswahl und -konfiguration.
• Überwachung der System-Governance, des Benutzerzugriffs, der Datensicherheit und der Einhaltung der Unternehmens-IT- und Datenschutzrichtlinien.
• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über Branchentrends und neue Technologien, die Innovationen in allen Sulzer-Divisionen vorantreiben. Dies kann die Implementierung neuer Tools oder Technologien, die Aktualisierung bestehender Systeme oder die Erkundung neuer Lösungen zur Steigerung des Geschäftswerts umfassen. Um erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
• >15 Jahre
• Erfahrung mit Salesforce, Microsoft CRM, Ausschreibung, Preisgestaltung, Produktkonfigurationstools usw.
• Hohes Englischniveau
• Ein starkes Verständnis von Geschäftsverkäufen, Ma-Rketing- und Ausschreibungsprozessen und
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Le chef de groupe IT est responsable de la définition et de l'exécution de la stratégie informatique pour le groupe, en assurant l'alignement sur les priorités opérationnelles et les objectifs de transformation numérique à long terme. Ce rôle dirige plusieurs fonctions informatiques, supervise la gouvernance technologique et assure la sécurité, l'évolutivité et la modernisation des infrastructures et des systèmes qui soutiennent les opérations mondiales. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux cadres supérieurs qui participent à l'élaboration de la stratégie à moyen et à long terme (3-5 ans) pour leur secteur d'activité ou leur secteur fonctionnel. Responsable de l'exécution de la stratégie et de la direction opérationnelle d'une entreprise ou d'une fonction. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants de groupe sur des questions d'importance stratégique pour l'organisation. Il gère généralement plusieurs équipes. Dans le cadre de notre parcours de transformation, Sulzer recherche un leader stratégique, dynamique et pratique dans le domaine des ventes et du marketing IT qui pilotera des initiatives cruciales telles que l'harmonisation des plateformes de vente mondiales. Ce rôle représente une position de leader clé dans l'un des domaines informatiques les plus critiques pour les entreprises, permettant directement l'excellence commerciale et accélérant la croissance des revenus en équipant les équipes de vente de capacités évolutives, axées sur les données et intégrées, alignées sur les ambitions de croissance de Sulzer. Principales responsabilités
• Définir et piloter la vision et la stratégie globale IT Sales & Marketing alignées sur les priorités d'excellence commerciale de Sulzer.
• Offrez avec votre équipe quelques-unes des initiatives informatiques et des programmes de transformation les plus critiques, permettant directement à nos équipes commerciales d'exécuter leur stratégie de croissance et d'accélérer la production de revenus.
• Diriger et diriger avec succès la consolidation, l'harmonisation et la modernisation du paysage mondial de la CRM, y compris la pleine migration vers Salesforce pour améliorer significativement l'excellence et la performance des ventes.
• Diriger la modernisation des capacités du CPQ pour accélérer et améliorer les processus de conversion des commandes, tout en tirant parti du marketing numérique et des plateformes de commerce électronique de la prochaine génération pour débloquer de nouveaux flux de revenus et stimuler durablement la croissance des ventes.
• Partenaire avec le leadership des ventes, le marketing, la gestion de produits, et la division d'utilisation p artners pour façonner les feuilles de route et prioriser la demande des entreprises.
• Assurer l'harmonisation des solutions technologiques avec la stratégie commerciale et commerciale, les objectifs de l'expérience utilisateur et les normes d'intégrité des données.
• Favoriser la collaboration et une culture de haute performance au sein de l'équipe d'excellence en TI des ventes
• J'ai dentifié avec vos cadres les domaines d'amélioration, de consolidation et de normalisation.
• Développer davantage une équipe de haute performance : L ead, mentor, et développer une équipe multifonctionnelle et multiculturelle de >10 professionnels de l'informatique sur plusieurs géographies, afin d'assurer la mise en œuvre réussie s et le cycle de vie des applications de vente.
• Gérer les fournisseurs externes et les intégrateurs de systèmes pour fournir des projets et des services d'appui conformes aux attentes budgétaires et de qualité.
• Propre et évoluer le paysage mondial des applications de Sulzer, y compris Salesforce CRM, Microsoft Dynamics CRM, les outils CPQ (Configure-Price-Quote) et les outils de conception technique pour la sélection et la configuration des produits.
• Superviser la gouvernance du système, l'accès des utilisateurs, la sécurité des données et le respect des politiques ministérielles en matière de TI et de confidentialité des données.
• Restez informé des tendances de l'industrie et des nouvelles technologies qui stimulent l'innovation dans toutes les divisions de Sulzer. Il peut s'agir de mettre en oeuvre de nouveaux outils ou technologies, de moderniser les systèmes existants ou d'explorer de nouvelles solutions pour générer davantage de valeur commerciale. Pour réussir, vous avez besoin :
• > 15 ans
• Expérimenté avec Salesforce, Microsoft CRM, Appel d'offres, Tarification, Outils de Configuration Produit etc.
• Niveau élevé d'anglais
• Une bonne compréhension des processus de vente, de soumission et d'appel d'offres

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Madrid, Spain. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable, whilst contributing to the success of a newly established office in central Madrid. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organisation, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Madrid office, supporting our European companies. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center
• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers
• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.
• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.
• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFR.
• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.
• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields
• 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable
• Very good written and verbal communication skills
• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)
• Fluent English skills
• Any other European language is a plus
• Analytical and problema solving skills What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner. Key Responsibilities:
• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit
• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data
• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits
• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables
• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments
• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow
• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms
• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization
• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers
• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement
• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable
• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems
• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role Minimum Job Requirements/Skillset:
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role
• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred
• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes
• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills
• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala )
• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus What we offer you
• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )
• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching
• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition
• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)
• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance
• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offerin

About the role Job Summary The Painter is responsible for working with production to prepare finished pumps for the customer. Responsibilities
• Manage material movement through the department which aligns with the most immediate needs of internal customers to meet On-Time-Delivery (OTD) performance metrics.
• Operate overhead and manual floor lifting equipment to maneuver, load, and unload items onto and off of the paint line that exceed 50lbs.

• Apply paint and any additional finishes according to sales order and work instructions.
• Read and interpret drawings, technical specifications and material data sheets.
• Maintain accurate and complete records as required.
• Perform quality inspections as described in quality plans and work instructions.
• Follow quality procedures according to ISO 9001.
• Commitment to following all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to, proper use of required PPE at all times. Requirements
• High school diploma or equivalent
• 1+ years of industrial or automotive painting experience
• Ability to wear a respirator
• Ability to read, write, and communicate in English
• Reliable transportation
• Ability to pass 7-year criminal history background check
• Ability to pass a hair follicle drug screen What we offer you
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• 12 paid holidays
• 15 days of PTO
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Area Sales Manager (ASM) is the primary external representative of Sulzer to our clients. The ASM is assigned a geographic or product specific sales area and is financially responsible for the Order Intake (OI), Gross Profit Margin (GPM) and Operating Net Cash-Flow (ONCF) of the assigned areas budget for the company. The ASM finds and develops sales opportunities and engages with clients on these thru closure of orders, and until projects have been completed within Sulzer. The ASM will take direction from and meet or exceed sales targets set by the RSM. In this role, the ASM will properly and proactively represent Sulzer to our clients. ASMs engage clients and are expected to be role models for the company within our larger Sulzer community. The ASM will work closely with other Sulzer Turbo teams to include: Inside Sales, Business Process, Operations, Engineering, Finance, QC, Safety and HR to secure, ship and invoice profitable orders. As a Sales Leader, the ASM will also understand, engage with, promote and represent Sulzer’s RES businesses (Pumps and EMS) to provide a full complement of RES Services to the region. Responsibilities
• Meet or exceed the Order Intake budget for the assigned area/product line
• Develop, sell and maintain all business responsibility for the assigned area/product line
• Develop and implement sales strategies consistent with the goals of Sulzer
• Plan, support and monitor sales activity within the area/product line
• Develop and deliver technically and commercially superior proposals to the client
• Support all business activities with the client thru closing and invoicing
• Develop, maintain and report accurate sales forecasts
• Review RFPs, contracts, POs and terms for all business opportunities
• Control all business expenses as if they were your own
• Be proficient with and maintain Salesforce: opportunities, outage tracking and market condition events, trip call reports and competition updates
• Coordinate, plan, attend and execute promotional trade shows events
• Participate in quarterly sales calls or meetings with the management team
• This position requires and expects frequent travel into the area assigned.
• Support Sulzer strategic initiatives on safety, business, ethics and quality.
• Present a positive, proactive, professional attitude and appearance at all times. Qualifications:
• High personal standards of character. Must have impeccable moral and ethical behavior.
• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business is preferred. In lieu of this, the candidate will have at least 5 years of industry knowledge and experience with Turbomachinery.
• Previously experience of pro-actively influencing or closing business with clients, co-workers and/or commercial peers.
• Commercial and technical knowledge and abilities to perform the external sales position.
• In-depth knowledge of turbomachinery and Sulzer’s complete product line
• Must be able to understand, interpret and discuss technical and commercial documents.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to read, write and discuss micro details and macro situations, as well as the inter-personal skills to interface with personnel from diverse backgrounds at all levels of our clients organization.
• A willingness to travel frequently and bring business back as a result.
• The ASM is a leadership position that requires strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously as well as the ability to willingly work with demanding deadlines
• This position requires and demands exceptional time management skills
• Understanding of basic financial statements
• Proficiency at or the ability to quickly learn how to use Sales

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group Data & Analytics Sr. Analyst is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reports and dashboards, and providing insights to support strategic and operational decisions. This role ensures data accuracy and supports data governance initiatives. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Regional Data Analyst Job Description | Business Intelligence Team Sulzer offers a wealth of opportunities to drive your career in the direction you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step. Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team as we accelerate our data transformation across the Services Division. This is a role at the intersection of business intelligence, analytics, and technology — for someone who not only understands what the business needs and translates it into impactful dashboards and analysis, but who actively looks for smarter, faster ways to do it. We are not looking for someone who waits to be handed a tool. We want someone with a builder mindset — who sees a repetitive process and immediately thinks about how to streamline it, who stays genuinely close to what technology can do, and who brings proposals to the table without being asked. About the Role As a Business Intelligence & Data Analyst, you will serve as the bridge between regional business stakeholders and our data ecosystem. You will own dashboard development end-to-end, support data quality and governance, and act as a trusted analytics resource for teams spanning Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain. Beyond delivery, you will be expected to continuously challenge how things are done — identifying opportunities to leverage emerging tools and technologies to make the team and the business work smarter. What You Will Be Doing Dashboard Development & Governance
• Gather and translate business requirements into well-structured, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses
• Develop and maintain dashboards in Qlik Sense, ensuring consistent look, feel, and logic across all BI outputs
• Manage development as a project — define scope, align with stakeholders, meet deadlines, and iterate based on feedback
• Develop a deep understanding of our data ecosystem — sources, structures, and how data flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms
• Ensure all dashboards are self-explanatory, actionable, and require minimal training to use
• Maintain documentation of dashboards, data models, and processes
• Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance forums as a reference point for end-users across the region Data Quality & Governance
• Proactively identify data quality issues and support the relevant teams to define and implement improvement procedures Analytics & Insights
• Proactively analyse trends across the region, sub-regions, and product lines to surface relevant business insights
• Serve as the primary analytics resource for the region, supporting teams with complex questions that go beyond standard dashboard views
• Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses — leveraging the best available tools to deliver faster, more thorough insights
• Actively engage with regional and sub-regional management to understand their data requirements and support strategic decisions
• Guide regional ambassadors on how to navigate and use existing dashboards independently Training & Enablement
• Design and deliver training sessions on effective use of BI dashboards and data tools
• Build a culture of data literacy across the region
• Act as a consultant and help desk contact for dashboard-related questions Insight Communication
• Support

Kom werken bij het Sulzer Turbo Services, onderdeel van Sulzer Services, een van 's werelds meest geavanceerde onafhankelijke aanbieders van reparatie, revisie en onderhoud binnen de turbine-industrie. Vanuit Venlo (Lomm) of op locatie, bieden wij onze klanten wereldwijd solide, klantgerichte en flexibele ondersteuning voor hun compressoren, stoom- en gasturbines. Sluit je aan bij onze trotse en hoogopgeleide internationale crew als Constructiewerker Rotorshop Mechanic (BBL opleiding). Je werkt 4 dagen per week op onze locatie in Lomm en 1 dag per week ga je naar school. In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Nauwkeurige demontage/inspectie/probleemoplossing/reparatie/montage van diverse roterende apparatuur (gasturbines, stoomturbines en compressoren) volgens Sulzer-specificaties
• Gebruik van handgereedschap, hydraulische spanapparatuur, takels, krikken, winkelhaken, linialen, micrometers, schietloden en speciaal gereedschap voor de uitvoering van de werkzaamheden Om in deze functie te slagen, moet je:
• Een proactieve houding hebben en leergierig zijn
• Teamplayer zijn die zich thuis voelt in een dynamische wereld en graag het werk van een rotorshop mechanic wilt leren
• Flexibel zijn en open houding hebben
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands hebben
• Het leuk vinden om te leren werken binnen een internationaal opererend bedrijf What we offer you Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan voordelen, waaronder:

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary A winder disassembles, repairs, rewinds, and reassembles electric motors, and generators. Pasadena, Texas ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.
• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).
• Disassemble electro-mechanical equipment noting parts identifications, configuration and condition.
• Clean electro-mechanical equipment assemblies as needed using various methods and steps, including but not limited to: parts washer/steamers, caustic tanks, glass beaders, etc.
• Measure for or note proper replacement parts. Correctly requisition needed items from storekeeper, as approved by supervisor.
• Replace or repair worn or defective mechanical or electro-mechanical assemblies, including but not limited to: bearings, brushes, brush holders, motors leads gears seals, impellers, mechanical switches, brakes clutches, clutch rotors, tachs, fans, end shield,, etc.
• Retest reassembled electro-mechanical equipment for proper output and operation.
• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.
• Operate specialized repair and testing equipment and other equipment as needed
• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.
• Keep work area neat and clean as directed by supervisor.
• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.
• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor QUALIFICATIONS:
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Basic mechanical aptitude PHYSICAL DEMANDS
• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.
• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds The above is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities, or requirements. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a RTR Accountant to join our Accounting team in Spain to help us take our Record to Report (RTR) area to the next level. As an Accountant, you will collaborate with multiple countries and engage with a diverse array of areas stakeholders, including Accounting, Reporting, Analytics, Country Finance Heads, Global Process Owners (GPOs), and external parties such as auditors and tax authorities. Key responsabilities:
• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues
• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations
• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records
• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes
• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations
• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements
• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider
• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger
• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)
• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates
• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role
• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA
• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances) You need to succeed:
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting
• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills
• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment
• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership
• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software
• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus
• Proficiency in English and French What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets.
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios, making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits. International applicants are welcome to apply. No visa or w

Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il ruolo è responsabile per i prodotti di saldatura per garantire che soddisfino gli standard di qualità e sicurezza. Questo ruolo supporta il processo di produzione identificando difetti, mantenendo le attrezzature e seguendo i protocolli di produzione. Responsabilità del lavoro
• Prodotti di saldatura secondo le specifiche.
• Ispezione di beni finiti per difetti e problemi di relazione.
• Mantenere e pulire attrezzature di produzione.
• Seguire gli standard di sicurezza e qualità.
• Attività di produzione e risultati dei test.
• Assistere nella risoluzione dei problemi e nella manutenzione di base.
• Collabora con i membri del team per raggiungere gli obiettivi di produzione. Qualifiche
• Può richiedere la formazione professionale di base e fino a 2 anni di esperienza rilevante.
• Competenze meccaniche e tecniche di base.
• Attenzione ai dettagli e alla capacità di seguire le istruzioni.
• Buone capacità di comunicazione e di lavoro di squadra.
• Familiarità con procedure di sicurezza e qualità.
• Volontà di imparare e crescere in un ambiente di produzione. Cosa ti offriamo
• 11 giorni festivi e massimo 15 giorni di ferie annuali.
• Assicurazione commerciale supplementare.
• Esame fisico annuale.
• Feste e regali di compleanno.
• Premi di servizio lunghi.

Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sudafrica, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The role is responsible for welding products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols. Job Responsibilities
• Welder products according to specifications.
• Inspect finished goods for defects and report issues.
• Maintain and clean production equipment.

• Good communication and teamwork abilities.
• Familiarity with safety and quality procedures.

• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.
• Supplementary Commercial Insurance.
• Annual Physical Examination.
• Festival & Birthday Gifts.
• Long service awards.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. • Befolgen Sie Sicherheit und Qualitätsstandards.
• Dokumentenproduktionsaktivitäten und Testergebnisse.
• Unterstützung bei der Fehlersuche und grundlegenden Wartung.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Teammitgliedern zusammen, um die Produktionsziele zu erreichen. Qualifikationen
• Kann eine berufliche Grundausbildung und bis zu 2 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung erfordern.
• Grundlegende mechanische und technische Fähigkeiten.
• Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Fähigkeit, Anweisungen zu befolgen.
• Gute Kommunikation und Teamfähigkeit.
• Vertrautheit mit Sicherheits- und Qualitätsverfahren.
• Bereitschaft, in einer Produktionsumgebung zu lernen und zu wachsen. Was wir Ihnen bieten
• 11 Feiertage und höchstens 15 Urlaubstage.
• Zusätzliche gewerbliche Versicherung.
• Jährliche körperliche Untersuchung.
• Festival & Geburtstagsgeschenke.
• Long Service Awards.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le rôle est de souder les produits pour s'assurer qu'ils répondent aux normes de qualité et de sécurité. Ce rôle appuie le processus de fabrication en identifiant les défauts, en maintenant l'équipement et en suivant les protocoles de production. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Produits de soudage selon les spécifications.
• Inspecter les produits finis pour déceler les défauts et signaler les problèmes.
• Entretien et nettoyage du matériel de production.
• Suivre les normes de sécurité et de qualité.
• Documenter les activités de production et les résultats des essais.
• Aider au dépannage et à l'entretien de base.
• Collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe pour atteindre les objectifs de production. Compétences
• Peut nécessiter une formation professionnelle de base et jusqu'à 2 ans d'expérience pertinente.
• Compétences mécaniques et techniques de base.
• Attention aux détails et capacité de suivre les instructions.
• Bonnes capacités de communication et de travail d'équipe.
• Connaissance des procédures de sécurité et de qualité.
• Volonté d'apprendre et de grandir dans un environnement manufacturier. Ce que nous vous offrons
• 11 jours fériés et 15 jours de congé annuel maximum.
• Assurance commerciale complémentaire.
• Examen physique annuel.
• Festival & Cadeaux d'anniversaire.
• Prix de longue durée.
• Bus de navette. Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'une main-d'oeuvre diversifiée et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Product Engineer reports to Team Leader ORE. Responsibilities:
• Management of the assigned mechanical design projects from Sales order review stage to handover to production.
• Undertake responsibility for order related design, processing and supporting activities for the assigned product range.
• Review of the customer project design specifications, communication with Sales/Tendering team to transform the customer requirements into product through order related engineering.
• Preparation of the customer facing documents as Pump Cross Section drawings, Pump General Arrangement drawings, P&ID drawings, Wiring diagram etc in 2D or 3D.
• Review and approval of buyout component drawings & documents related to Motor, Coupling, Mechanical Seal & Systems, ARC Valves, Gear box, VFD, Turbine etc.
• Review of the Instruments requirement & co-ordination with Instrumentation team.
• Preparation, check & release of the Bill Of Material (BOM) in SAP ERP.
• Communicate with Customers & sub-suppliers as necessary.
• Support & coordinate with different teams of Operations, Purchase, Sales, Quality & Testing during the complete cycle of the order execution.
• Provide engineering support to pump site commissioning team until successful operation of the equipment supplied.
• Proactively engage & support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement. Qualification, Experience and Knowledge requirement
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from reputed institute.
• 4-8 years of experience in Centrifugal Pump design field & API standards.
• Must have hands on experience on AutoCAD design software. Experience in Inventor, NX & Team center will be an added advantage.
• Conversant with the use of the SAP ERP tool.
• Independent and proactive with good communication & interpersonal skills.
• Managed and executed multiple tasks while taking direction from several sources.
• High sense of ownership, strong work ethic, focused on details and results oriented. What we offer you 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays Defined contribution pension scheme Hospitalization insurance benefit On-site car parking Subsidized cafeteria Long service award Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role sits at the intersection of enterprise architecture, data governance, and business transformation. The Lead Architect – Data Quality works with business and IT leaders to redesign end-to-end processes and data flows so that high-quality data becomes the default outcome rather than a downstream correction effort. The position plays a central role in large-scale change initiatives (e.g., ERP modernization, MDM rollout, customer and material master harmonization, PLM integrations), providing a unique opportunity to create lasting architectural impact across Sulzer. Key Responsibilities
• Lead the design of enterprise data quality architecture and ensure preventive controls are embedded into processes and systems by default.
• Define and evolve enterprise data models, standards, critical data elements, and validation rules across priority domains (e.g., Customer, Material, Product).
• Drive root-cause elimination initiatives by redesigning processes, system interactions, and data ownership models.
• Define data quality KPIs and maturity tracking; monitor trends, risks, and progress and report transparently to governance bodies and management.
• Act as a key architectural contributor to data-related transformation programs (ERP, CRM, PLM, MDM, integration, analytics).
• Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture and IT leadership to shape future-state data and integration architecture decisions.
• Establish escalation mechanisms aligned with the enterprise data governance framework and enable consistent decision-making across Legal Entities.
• Contribute to evaluation and selection of data quality, governance, and MDM technologies and help define target-state capabilities. Candidate Profile
• University degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data quality, data governance, or related enterprise transformation roles.
• Strong understanding of data quality management and controls, enterprise data flows, integrations, and end-to-end business processes.
• Proven ability to perform root-cause analysis beyond symptoms and drive structural remediation.
• Strong conceptual thinking combined with pragmatic execution and delivery focus.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills in English Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a global industrial, engineering, or manufacturing environment.
• Hands-on exposure to enterprise application landscapes (SAP-centric environments such as S/4HANA/MDG, CRM, PLM, MDM).
• Experience working closely with Enterprise Architects or IT architecture teams.
• Relevant certification in data management, data governance, or architecture.
• Familiarity with modern integration patterns and data platforms (API-led integration, event-driven patterns, data lakes/warehouses) is a plus. Success Measures
• Recurring data quality issues are reduced through structural, preventive solutions.
• Data quality controls are embedded into business processes and system designs.
• Clear ownership and accountability for data quality issues are established and followed.
• Business and IT teams align on systemic data quality remediation rather than manual fixes.
• Enterprise data architecture decisions consistently reflect data quality and governance requirements What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role A mechanic is a professional who repairs and maintains machinery and parts. A mechanic's duties include inspecting, diagnosing, and fixing faults, conducting safety checks, and keeping records of the work done. A mechanic uses manual tools and technological devices to perform the tasks. A mechanic also communicates with customers and coworkers to establish timeframe and cost of each project. Mechanic/Technician-Night Shift Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Assemble machines utilizing the specified assembly checklist
• Disassemble and inspect machines utilizing the specified disassembly and inspection checklist
• Complete all documentation pertaining to the work assignment
• Communicate mechanical issues found during inspection to the appropriate Department Supervisor
• Work closely and clearly communicate with the other departments, Mechanical personnel, Supervisor and Lead Man To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Must be able to work overtime when necessary
• Must be able to use precision measuring instruments
• Must have experience working with turbo machinery repair
• Must have the required tools to perform their expected tasks What we offer you
• 11 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Manufacturing Quality Inspector is responsible for auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and outputs. This role ensures compliance with internal and regulatory standards and supports the timely delivery of quality products. This job profile is intended for support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. SUMMARY: Performs receipt and in-process dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies. Create and record inspection results on appropriate inspection report using Microsoft Excel and Word. Reviews sub-contractor procedures and reports; and maintains department records and procedures for current code requirements. Position functions independently with occasional guidance from the Quality Assurance Manager. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME 60% Performs dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies in accordance with appropriate specifications. 10% Monitors for compliance to processes and procedures. 10% Communicate with manufacturing personnel concerning priority of inspection. 10% Perform surveillance activities at Supplier facilities to determine compliance and acceptability of equipment/process being supplied. 10% Interfaces with 3rd party and Customer inspectors as required. SECONDARY RESPONSIBILIES
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in EHS Management System, including following safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
• Sulzer procedure review and implementation assistance.
• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
• Regular and reliable attendance with flexible work habits and schedule.
• Performs other duties as necessary SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:
• ASNT Certification for NDE Level I or Level II for PT, MT, UT and/or VT, preferred.
• Proficient in Microsoft and SAP applications
• Ability to read and interpret drawings, procedures, and specifications, define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
• Understanding appropriate application of inspection techniques
• Working knowledge of ASME, ASTM, AWS and other relative codes, preferred.
• Good written and oral communication, organizational skills, and ability to perform basic math.
• High School Diploma required. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Come Bid & Tendering Specialist sei un giocatore chiave nel tradurre i requisiti del cliente e le valutazioni del sito in costi di progetto dettagliati e precisi. Siete essenziali per garantire che le offerte per i servizi di attrezzature Steam Turbine & Compressor siano competitive, tecnicamente precise e commercialmente solide. Sarete responsabili dello sviluppo di proposte per progetti complessi, garantendo l'allineamento tra fattibilità tecnica, efficienza dei costi e successo commerciale. Role Location: Any Sulzer location. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Garantire un'accurata definizione di portata tecnica e gestione del rischio per complessi progetti di servizio Steam Turbine & Compressor (ad esempio ispezioni, riparazioni, fornitura di parti, soluzioni multi-train, ritiri, aggiornamenti e modifiche)
• Preparare la stima dei costi end-to-end e le quotazioni commerciali per progetti Steam Turbine & Compressor basati su specifiche tecniche
• Coinvolgere e collaborare con successo con i clienti e i partner esterni (ad esempio venditori / subappaltatori) e con gli stakeholder interni
• Sostenere le attività post-tender, assicurando una transizione regolare dall'offerta all'esecuzione, compresa la validazione del campo e la briefing del progetto
• Contribuisci all'approvvigionamento e all'efficienza dei costi lavorando a stretto contatto con i fornitori per garantire prezzi ottimali, tempi di consegna e qualità per parti e servizi correlati
• Migliorare costantemente i metodi di stima dei costi per migliorare l'accuratezza e l'efficienza nelle strategie dei prezzi Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Qualifica riconosciuta in ingegneria meccanica o disciplina correlata. Siamo anche aperti a considerare gli ingegneri di vendita o gli ingegneri di progetto con proposte / offerta / esperienza di offerta che stanno cercando un nuovo percorso di carriera.
• Forte esperienza nei servizi rotanti di attrezzature, bonifica di officina e processi di riparazione. Espulsione essenziale con Turbina a vapore / apparecchiature di compressione multistadio.
• Familiarità con catene di fornitura di servizio e riparazione.
• Competenze analitiche e mentalità commerciale
• Personalità attiva e orientata alla soluzione con forti capacità interpersonali Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo in una zona in rapida crescita del nostro business.
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• Pacchetto di stipendio competitivo con benefici attraenti, regime pensionistico e programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Opportunità emozionanti per la crescita e il progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. As Bid & Tendering Specialist you are a key player in translating client requirements and site assessments into detailed, accurate project costings. You are essential in ensuring that tenders for Steam Turbine & Compressor equipment services are competitive, technically precise, and commercially sound. You will be responsible for developing proposals for complex projects, ensuring alignment between technical feasibility, cost efficiency, and commercial success. Role Location: Any Sulzer location. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Ensuring thorough technical scope definition and risk management for complex Steam Turbine & Compressor service projects (e.g. inspections, repairs, parts supply, multi-train solutions, rerates, upgrades and modifications)
• Prepare end-to-end cost estimation and commercial quotations for Steam Turbine & Compressor projects based on technical specifications
• Engage and collaborate successfully with clients and external partners (e.g. vendors / subcontractors) as well internal stakeholders
• Support post-tender activities, ensuring smooth transition from bid to execution, including scope validation and project briefing
• Contribute to procurement and cost efficiency by working closely with suppliers to secure optimal pricing, lead times and quality for related parts and services
• Continuously improve cost estimation methods to improve accuracy and efficiency in pricing strategies To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Recognised qualification in mechanical engineering or a related discipline. We are also open to considering Sales Engineers or Project Engineers with proposals/ bid / tendering experience who are seeking a new career path.
• Strong experience in rotating equipment services, workshop reclamation, and repair processes. Essential expereince with Steam Turbine / Multistage Compression equipment.
• Familiarity with service and repair supply chains.
• Thorough analytical skills and commercial mindset
• Proactive, solution-oriented personality with strong interpersonal skills What we offer you
• Chance to make a significant impact in a rapidly growing area of our business.
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance programs
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
