Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Als Bid & Tendering Specialist sind Sie ein wichtiger Akteur bei der Übersetzung von Kundenanforderungen und Standortbewertungen in detaillierte, genaue Projektkosten. Sie sind unerlässlich, um sicherzustellen, dass die Ausschreibungen für Steam Turbine & Compressor Equipment Services wettbewerbsfähig, technisch präzise und kommerziell einwandfrei sind. Sie sind für die Entwicklung von Vorschlägen für komplexe Projekte verantwortlich und gewährleisten die Abstimmung zwischen technischer Machbarkeit, Kosteneffizienz und kommerziellem Erfolg. Rollenstandort: Jeder Sulzer-Standort. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Sicherstellung einer gründlichen technischen Festlegung des Umfangs und des Risikomanagements für komplexe Steam Turbine & Compressor Serviceprojekte (z. B. Inspektionen, Reparaturen, Teileversorgung, Multi-Train-Lösungen, Rerates, Upgrades und Modifikationen)
• Bereiten Sie eine End-to-End-Kostenschätzung und kommerzielle Angebote für Dampfturbinen- und Kompressorprojekte auf der Grundlage technischer Spezifikationen vor
• Engagieren und arbeiten Sie erfolgreich mit Kunden und externen Partnern (z. B. Lieferanten / Subunternehmern) sowie internen Stakeholdern zusammen
• Unterstützung von Aktivitäten nach der Ausschreibung, Gewährleistung eines reibungslosen Übergangs von der Gebotsabgabe zur Ausführung, einschließlich Umfangsvalidierung und Projekt-Briefing
• Beitrag zur Beschaffung und Kosteneffizienz durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit Lieferanten, um optimale Preise, Durchlaufzeiten und Qualität für zugehörige Teile und Dienstleistungen zu gewährleisten
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Kostenschätzungsmethoden zur Verbesserung der Genauigkeit und Effizienz der Preisstrategien Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
• Anerkannte Qualifikation im Maschinenbau oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Wir sind auch offen für Sales Engineers oder Project Engineers mit Vorschlägen / Angebot / Ausschreibung Erfahrung, die einen neuen Karriereweg suchen.
• Starke Erfahrung in rotierenden Ausrüstungsdienstleistungen, Werkstattrückgewinnung und Reparaturprozessen. Wesentliche Erfahrung mit Steam Turbine / Multistage Compression Equipment.
• Vertrautheit mit Service- und Reparaturlieferketten.
• Gründliche analytische Fähigkeiten und kommerzielle Denkweise
• Proaktive, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit starken zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Spannende Möglichkeiten für berufliches Wachstum und Fortschritt in einer dynamischen und sich entwickelnden Branche Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und engagieren uns für ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld. Wir sind stolz darauf, als Top Employer 2026 in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, Großbritannien und den USA anerkannt zu werden.

Vous êtes essentiel pour garantir que les appels d'offres pour les services d'équipement de turbine à vapeur et compresseur sont compétitifs, techniquement précis et commercialement sains. Vous serez responsable de l'élaboration de propositions pour des projets complexes, assurant l'alignement entre faisabilité technique, rentabilité et succès commercial. Lieu du rôle : n'importe quel emplacement de Sulzer. Vos principales tâches et responsabilités:
• Assurer une définition technique approfondie et une gestion des risques pour les projets complexes de service de turbine à vapeur et de compresseur (p. ex. inspections, réparations, fourniture de pièces, solutions multi-trains, réapprovisionnements, mises à niveau et modifications)
• Préparer une estimation des coûts de bout en bout et des devis commerciaux pour les projets de turbine à vapeur et de compresseur sur la base de spécifications techniques
• Engager et collaborer avec succès avec les clients et les partenaires externes (p. ex. fournisseurs/sous-traitants) ainsi qu'avec les intervenants internes
• Appuyer les activités postérieures à l ' appel d ' offres, en assurant une transition sans heurts entre la soumission et l ' exécution, y compris la validation de la portée et l ' exposé des projets
• Contribuer à l'approvisionnement et à l'efficacité des coûts en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les fournisseurs pour obtenir des prix, des délais et une qualité optimaux pour les pièces et services connexes

• Personnalité proactive, orientée vers la solution, dotée de solides compétences interpersonnelles Ce que nous vous offrons

• Ensemble de salaires concurrentiels comportant des prestations attrayantes, un régime de retraite et des programmes d'aide aux employés
• Possibilités de croissance et d'avancement professionnels dans une industrie dynamique et en évolution Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production or service center activities, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Job Description:
• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.
• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.
• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.
• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system
• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.
• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.
• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request
• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative
• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.
• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.
• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.
• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.
• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop Requirements:
• Diploma’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering
• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment
• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage
• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators
• Fluent in English
• Team player
• Well organized and structured
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Pro-active and self-motivated minset
• Multi-tasking
• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment
• Willingness to travel and work on project sites. What we offer you Career Opportunities Saving Plan Medical Benefit Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Job Summary The Operations / Manufacturing / Production Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily production or service center activities, ensuring that processes run smoothly, efficiently, and safely. This role supervises professional-level staff and ensures adherence to quality standards and production or service schedules. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Job Description:
• Pre-commissioning and commissioning of installed, repaired or overhauled rotating equipment.
• If required supervise and assist with the DIRA of rotating equipment and associated auxiliary equipment according to technical drawings and specifications.
• Systematic trouble shooting, root cause analysis and rectification on mechanical, electrical and instrumentation component and systems with consideration on quality, time and cost.
• Lead for start up and testing of new installations/erections or overhauled units of rotating equipment including mechanical part, electrical part, instruments and control system
• Monitor field sequence activities based on agreed scope and schedule and report regularly to office.
• Ensure that all findings and work is clearly reported in writing.
• Work assignment could be at shop or field service depends on customer projects request
• Communicate with customer or third party on site as RES representative
• Ensures that all works and activities are done in line with the ISO procedures, as well as the HSE and company regulations.
• Preventing accident, conduct walk thru and observation.
• Campaign using Stop Work Authority to their subordinate when any unsafe Act and condition then record by using observation card.
• Review HIRADC effectiveness. Ensure working area safe for everyone.
• Coordinate with Project OPC, Sales, Engineering and workshop Requirements:
• Diploma’s or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering
• Preferably with minimum 5 years experience working on repairing rotating equipment
• Have experience in the OEM will be an advantage
• Have knowledge on repair or overhaul turbine generators
• Fluent in English
• Team player
• Well organized and structured
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Pro-active and self-motivated minset
• Multi-tasking
• Must have experience in installation, maintenance and troubleshooting of rotating equipment
• Willingness to travel and work on project sites. What we offer you Career Opportunities Saving Plan Medical Benefit Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Wexford is looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer ( Project Manager ) that is product development focussed, giving you responsibility from concept through to prototype, testing, and successful product introduction. You’ll help lead the next generation of submersible pumps and agitators, supporting our mission to deliver high‑performance, high‑reliability solutions for water recycling and sustainable operations worldwide. About Sulzer Wexford With over 250+ employees on site, Sulzer Wexford is a key engineering and manufacturing hub within Sulzer’s global network. The team’s work underpins critical water recycling, sustainability, and energy‑efficiency solutions used around the world. What you’ll be doing
• Lead end‑to‑end product development projects using best‑practice project management methods.
• Design and develop new products, primarily submersible pumps and agitators — translating requirements into high‑performance, high‑reliability solutions.
• Oversee the build, test, and validation of prototypes, including detailed reporting, interpretation, and analysis of results.
• Support smooth introduction of new products into manufacturing and global markets.
• Act as the point of contact, collaborating with customers, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure engineering, quality, and commercial alignment. Who will succeed here?
• You will hold a formal qualification in Mechanical Engineering
• Someone able to translate requirements into practical, innovative product solutions
• A hands‑on problem solver with experience in testing, analysis, and validation
• A confident communicator comfortable working with diverse stakeholders
• Someone excited by the opportunity to influence the next generation of engineered products What we offer you
• A competitive base salary
• Flex time with core hours of 09:30–14:30
• 26 days annual leave
• A defined pension contribution
• Free on‑site parking with reduced‑rate EV charging
• Subsidised on‑site canteen
• Maternity/paternity leave top‑up
• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways for continuous professional development
• Genuine opportunities for international mobility and long‑term progression Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role To establish and maintain financial and management procedures for Sulzer entities in Libya ensuring compliance with all internal standards, controls and implementing best practice whilst meeting internal customer satisfaction goals and the company’s overall corporate strategy 1. Lead the legal entity as a Finance business partner / LE Finance head. 2. Plan, develop and implement Finance strategy ensuring that it meets overall corporate needs and departmental KPI. 3. Support business partner in developing entity’s strategies by providing recommendations to strategically enhance financial performance and business opportunities. 4. Responsible for end-to-end accounting for the legal entity including the banking transactions. 5. Responsible for compliance and Internal Control Systems (ICS) for legal entity. 6. Responsible for reviewing contracts with legal & doing Financial due diligence reviews for all agents (If any). 7. Responsible for monthly forecasts, monthly reporting, annual budgets, Internal and External audits for legal entity. 8. Analyse financial results, identify and communicate deviations from forecasts with recommendations for solutions and improvements. 9. Responsible for Accounts Receivable & collections. 10. descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Sulzer Chemtech fertigt Stoffaustauschkomponenten für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Produktionsmitarbeiter im Bereich «Biege-, Laser- und Stanzmaschinen» sind verantwortlich die Fertigung von Bauteilen für unsere Verteiler, Böden, und anderen Kolonneneinbauten.

Sulzer bietet Ihnen eine Vielfalt von Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere in die von Ihnen gewünschte Richtung zu lenken, je nach Ihren Fähigkeiten und Interessen. Wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt zu tun.

Karrierechance: Mitarbeiter/in für die Herstellung von strukturierten Packungen (m/w/d) bei Sulzer Chemtech in Essen. Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Herstellen von strukturierten Packungen nach Vorgaben und Zeitplänen

• Arbeitsplätze: Stanzen und Nuten, Biegen, Schneiden, Montieren, Qualitätskontrolle, Verpacken

• Arbeiten an automatischen und halbautomatischen Produktionslinien mit maßgeschneiderten Produktionsanlagen

• Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb

• Durchführung von Einstellungen und Anpassungen von Maschinen zur Gewährleistung von Geschwindigkeit und Qualität der Produktionsleistung

• Mitwirkung bei der Durchführung von Projekten an allen Arbeitsplätzen in der strukturierten Verpackungswerkstatt

• Meldung von Nichtkonformitäten und Abweichungen von den Produktionsplänen an den Vorarbeiter der Verpackungswerkstatt

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit der Qualitätsabteilung

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit allen relevanten Richtlinien, Prozessen und Standardarbeitsanweisungen

• Arbeit in Übereinstimmung mit den Richtlinien für Umwelt, Sicherheit und Gesundheit

• Andere produktionsbezogene Aufgaben und Projekte nach Zuweisung.

Anforderungen:

• Handwerkliche / Technische Ausbildung, Werkstattausbildung

• Mindestens 3-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in diesen Bereichen

• Expertise: Kenntnisse der Fertigungsverfahren Schneiden, Stanzen, Biegen und Schweißen von Blechen

• Affinität zu aufmerksamer und qualitätsorientierter Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und Nationalität

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse

What we offer you

Wir bieten:

• Attraktive Vergütung

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• JobRad

• Kostenlose Parkplätze auf dem Betriebsgelände

• Betriebliche Sonderleistungen (z.B. Altersvorsorge, Familienservice-Hotline)

Für diese Stelle können wir keine Unterstützung zum Erhalt eines Visums oder einer Arbeitserlaubnis bieten.

Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit und Gleichbehandlung fördert. Wir setzen uns für personelle Vielfalt ein.
83 % unserer Mitarbeitenden empfehlen Sulzer als guten Arbeitgeber und wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, China, Deutschland, der Schweiz, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den Vereinigten Staaten als Top-Arbeitgeber 2024 ausgezeichnet zu sein. Kommen Sie und nehmen Sie an unserer Geschichte teil!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Design Engineer è responsabile per la progettazione, la costruzione, la manutenzione e la riparazione di impianti e macchinari. Ciò include la creazione di standard per il controllo dell'inquinamento, il test e la manutenzione, e la raccomandazione di nuove attrezzature e sistemi. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. Scopo del lavoro Per produrre modelli 3D e disegni dettagliati 2D di componenti idraulici e di altre pompe basati su dati scansionati e/o disegni 2D legacy. Principali compiti e responsabilità
• Modellazione 3D e bozza (Siemens NX)
• Digitare componenti idraulici (Impellers, Volute Casing) da disegni legacy 2D e crea file centrali, corsi d'acqua 3D e disegni idraulici.
• Creazione di corsi d'acqua 3D e disegni idraulici da dati file centrali utilizzando strumenti interni SULZER.
• Modelli di superficie.
• Deve essere confortevole modellazione acquedotto complesso / superfici idrauliche.
• Utilizzando i dati importati per creare modelli. .iges o .stl dati di scansione saranno utilizzati per creare i modelli
• Abbonamento in NX. Deve essere comodo con:
• Aderendo a Sulzer standard di disegno per tutti i disegni
• Produrre disegni di colata che mostrerà una parte pre-macchinata (modelli di colata del segnaposto, corpi estratti in albero modello 3D ecc)
• Teamcenter / SAP
• Caricare e promuovere disegni / modelli
• Revising e aggiornamento disegni / modelli
• Creare attrezzature BOM in SAP Qualificazioni/esperienza e conoscenza richiesti
• Laurea / Diploma di Batchelor in Ingegneria Meccanica
• Esperienza rilevante all'interno dell'industria correlata, compresa la conoscenza delle pratiche e degli standard del settore.
• Competenza in Design e redazione utilizzando Siemens NX
• Buone competenze in inglese (scritto e verbale) Competenze e comportamenti richiesti
• Capacità di comunicazione
• Influenza e persuasione competenze
• Capacità di gestione delle relazioni
• Capacità di servizio clienti
• Capacità di gestione del tempo
• Capacità di agire indipendentemente.
• Flessibilità e capacità di adattarsi al cambiamento.
• Attenzione ai dettagli. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenbeschreibung Der Design Engineer ist für die Planung, den Bau, die Wartung und die Reparatur von Anlagengebäuden und Maschinen verantwortlich. Dazu gehören die Festlegung von Standards für die Kontrolle, Prüfung und Wartung von Schadstoffen sowie die Empfehlung neuer Geräte und Systeme. Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Zweck der Tätigkeit 3D-Modelle und 2D-Detailzeichnungen von Hydraulik- und anderen Pumpenkomponenten basierend auf gescannten Daten und/oder 2D-Altzeichnungen zu erstellen. Hauptaufgaben und Zuständigkeiten
• 3D Modellierung & Zeichnung (Siemens NX)
• Die Digitalisierung hydraulischer Komponenten (Impellers, Volute Casing) aus 2D-Legacy-Zeichnungen und erstellt zentrale Dateien, 3D-Wasserstraßen und Hydraulikzeichnungen.
• Erstellung von 3D-Wasserstraßen und hydraulischen Zeichnungen aus gegebenen zentralen Dateien mit SULZER Inhouse-Tools.
• Oberflächenmodellierung.
• Muss bequem sein, komplexe Wasserstraßen / hydraulische Oberflächen zu modellieren.
• Verwenden importierter Daten zum Erstellen von Modellen. .iges oder .stl Scan Daten werden verwendet, um die Modelle zu erstellen
• Entwurf in NX. Muss bequem sein mit:
• Einhaltung der Sulzer-Zeichnungsnormen für alle Zeichnungen
• Herstellung von Gusszeichnungen, die ein vorbearbeitetes Teil zeigen (Platzhaltergussmodelle, extrahierte Körper in 3D-Modellbaum usw.)
• Teamcenter / SAP
• Hochladen und Fördern von Zeichnungen / Modellen
• Überarbeitung und Aktualisierung von Zeichnungen / Modellen
• Erstellen von Equipment BOMs in SAP Qualifikationen/Erfahrung und erforderliches Wissen
• Batchelor’s Degree / Diplom in Maschinenbau
• Relevante Erfahrung in verwandten Branchen, einschließlich Kenntnissen der Branchenpraktiken und -standards.
• Design- und Entwurfskompetenz mit Siemens NX
• Gute Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und verbal) Erforderliche Kompetenzen und Verhaltensweisen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Warranty Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of complex warranty claims, acting as the primary interface between customers and internal stakeholders while applying advanced technical, commercial, and organizational expertise to ensure timely, compliant, and cost‑effective resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, prevent escalation, and protect the company’s commercial and reputational interests. Key Responsibilities Warranty Claims & Process Management
• Manage warranty claims as technical projects or standardized end-to-end processes from claim initiation through successful resolution and closure.
• Develop and maintain claim resolution plans, schedules, cost estimates, and closure criteria.
• Control and monitor claim progress against contractual obligations, internal policies, and agreed service levels (SLAs).
• Ensure full traceability, documentation integrity, and compliance throughout the warranty lifecycle. Customer & Stakeholder Interface
• Act as the single point of contact between the customer and internal stakeholders for all warranty-related matters.
• Maintain close, structured, and transparent communication with customers to manage expectations and avoid escalation.
• Coordinate internally with Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Service teams to enable timely and aligned resolutions.
• Facilitate technical and commercial discussions to achieve balanced, win–win outcomes within contractual and financial boundaries. Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline
• Control and monitor warranty claim expenditures to ensure alignment with the approved and allocated budget.
• Track actual warranty costs versus provisions and budgets, identifying variances proactively.
• Implement cost containment and optimization measures without compromising resolution effectiveness or customer satisfaction.
• Coordinate with Finance and relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate cost allocation, forecasting, and reporting.
• Support recovery actions from suppliers, sub-vendors, or third parties, where applicable, to minimize net warranty exposure. Technical Analysis & Problem Resolution
• Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis for complex or recurring warranty issues.
• Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure sustainable resolution and risk reduction.
• Escalate critical technical, quality, or commercial risks with clear impact assessment and recommendations. Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Management
• Ensure customer satisfaction throughout the warranty claim lifecycle by delivering timely, high-quality, and transparent claim resolution.
• Own customer feedback related to warranty claims, including collection, analysis, response, and closure.
• Address customer concerns proactively to prevent dissatisfaction and preserve long-term customer relationships.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our Process Solutions team and play a central part in the success of our licensed technologies. We are looking for an experienced leader to manage and grow our global aftermarket business. This business supplies essential solvents and catalysts to our customers in the refining, petrochemical, biofuels, and chemical recycling sectors. This role is key to providing our customers with valuable, long-term solutions. You will be responsible for the success of this business line, shaping its strategy and driving its growth. The role can be based in a number of locations: Winterthur/Allschwil, Singapore, Shanghai, Houston, or fully remote. Key roles and contributions:
• Define and execute a winning strategy for our solvent and catalyst business, creating synergy with Sulzer's licensed technologies.
• Make our product offerings stronger through smart pricing, effective market positioning, and good supplier partnerships.
• Oversee our solvent and catalyst products from development to end-of-life, including driving new innovations.
• Work closely with our technology and process solution teams to increase aftermarket sales.
• Keep track of industry trends, competitors, and new opportunities for business growth.
• Collaborate across departments to ensure our products and services meet customer needs. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, or a similar field.
• 10-15 years of experience in the refining, petrochemical, or chemical processing industries.
• A strong background in selling catalysts, solvents, or other industrial chemicals to these markets.
• Proven success in growing an aftermarket business for industrial products.
• A good understanding of process technologies, product portfolio management, and how solvents and catalysts are used.
• Experience with extraction technologies (such as BTX extraction) is a major plus.
• Excellent skills in strategic thinking, communication, negotiation, and leadership.
• Fluency in English is required. Other languages are an asset. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• A collaborative, diverse and innovation-driven culture
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group ESG Sr. Analyst is responsible for supporting ESG data management, reporting, and analysis. This role contributes to ESG initiatives by providing insights, tracking performance, and assisting in stakeholder communications. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The ESG Integration Manager plays a central role in integrating sustainability into Flow’s business processes in line with the Corporate ESG strategy. The position leads the deployment of ESG initiatives across Business Units and Legal Entities, supports the achievement of environmental targets, ensures robust ESG data and reporting, and promotes best practices, governance, and compliance. This role actively contributes to building a strong ESG culture across the organization. Main responsibilities:
• Deploy Flow sustainability roadmap in alignment with Corporate ESG strategy and Flow priorities
• Govern ESG within the division through the Sustainability Council
• Maintain and further develop ESG frameworks and lead implementation efforts
• Report, lead, prioritize, drive, and coordinate the division ESH related actions
• Actively manage ESG KPIs and ensure data integrity and availability
• Meet corporate environmental targets and track improvement projects reviews via project funnel
• Management and administration of the Flow Ideation platform in collaboration with other nominated colleagues and participation in the Flow Innovation Council.
• Propose necessary actions to achieve goal fulfillment and correct deviations
• Support as needed the non-financial reporting preparation
• Develop training material on safety awareness and environmental attention
• Communicate Sustainability targets, best practice and achievements
• Ensure compliance to ISO 14001, stay up to date on ESG regulation and legislation requirements
• Environment: coordinate the actions plans to reduce the environmental load as part of ESG program What you need to succeed:
• 5+ years of experience in Sustainability / ESG / ESH functions, gained in an in‑house or consulting environment, ideally with exposure to industrial or manufacturing sectors.
• Strong expertise in ESG project management, including sustainability KPIs, frameworks, governance, and reporting; solid understanding of global ESG trends and regulations.
• Proven knowledge of environmental management systems and processes, including ISO 14001 (internal auditor); experience with CSRD‑related data is a plus.
• Degree in Sustainability Management, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, or Business; Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification desired; SAP knowledge is an advantage.
• Excellent communication and leadership skills, fluent in English, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders, lead workshops, and work effectively in global, cross‑functional teams. What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are hiring a Pump Mechanic full time, day shift. You will be responsible for repairing and maintaining Sulzer Pumps’ and all other manufacturers’ pumping equipment while strictly adhering to customer, OEM and industry standard specifications. Job Responsibilities:
• Assembling all types of pump equipment to customers, OEM and industry standard specifications
• Disassembling equipment to gain access remove, clean and inspect components
• Inspecting & recording component measurements using instruments, tools and gages and providing inspection report
• Investigating and determining root cause failure
• Determining proper materials for repairs as per BOM
• Contouring impellers and pump casings to meet hydraulic requirements
• Setting and operating dynamic balancing equipment
• Performing final testing and inspections Qualifications:

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role If you love administration and thrive on being part of a growing, energetic business, we’d love to welcome you to our team. Our Sulzer Brisbane Service Centre is fast‑paced, collaborative and on an exciting growth journey, and we’re looking for an experienced admin professional to grow with us and make a real impact. Your main tasks and responsibilities
• General office admin including but not limited to reception activities, personnel queries e.g. travel and expenses and team coordination.
• Job package creation and admin including PO’s and Invoicing. This includes ensuring that all materials are accurately booked from stock to each job.
• System admin for materials and stock management. You will take control of the stock and be responsible for adequate supply. It is imperative that you effectively liaise with warehouse staff, drivers, suppliers and internal management by email and phone tenaciously.
• Accounts payable and receivable tasks - processing suppliers' invoices and customers for payment of invoices.
• General filing (manual and digital), data entry including payroll and reviewing wage reports to ensure 100% accuracy in a timely manner.
• Weekly on hand stock checks from list to ensure workshop consumables are consistently topped up, liaise with Management on levels to be ordered.
• Provide administration assistance to the Leadership Team as required.
• Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with legislative requirements, Company policies and procedures. What you bring to Sulzer
• 5+ Years' experience in Office Administration with purchasing and stores know how.
• You combine meticulous clerical skills with the practical mindset of a logistics professional.
• Reliability, friendly attitude and ability to liaise with blue collar to senior management personnel.
• Attention to detail.
• Strong computer skills with Microsoft suite, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent SAP/ERP systems.
• Strong communication skills.
• Sound ability to adapt in shared duties.
• High level skills in time management. What we offer you
• Be part of a fun, energetic and collaborative team.
• Annual salary reviews
• Employee Assistance Program
• On-site parking
• Work for a global organisation that values innovation, excellence and a commitment to the most important part of our business - our people and our customers. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Technical Field Advisor.This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. In this role you will be accountable for:
• Providing mechanical on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections, revisions, commissioning) of customer owned Power Generation Facilities utilizing Gas Turbines manufactured by Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric and MHI.
• Ensuring accurate installation, trouble shooting, maintenance and diagnostics of gas turbines and other rotating equipment according to Sulzer specifications
• Managing site activities like planning, integration and monitoring of resources and technical assistance based on agreed contractual work scope
• Supervising contract employees, manpower by providing directions, instructions, monitor quality and progress during gas turbine overhauls
• Ensuring all field activities are carried out safely complying with Sulzer’s QESH guidelines and procedures
• Reporting of all required job documentation (protocols, inspection reports, as –built drawings, work instructions, daily progress, defects and non-conformity etc.) properly and timely To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A vocational degree as a Technician
• 10 + years hands-on gas turbine experience and proven track record of executing overhaul projects
• Very good English language skills
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills What we offer you
• A more than competitive salary
• A generous number of holidays (40)
• A solid pension scheme
• Training opportunities Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Start your career at Sulzer’s Falkirk Service Centre, the specialist hub for high‑voltage testing, repair and refurbishment of large industrial equipment. This is where complex, heavy‑duty engineering comes to life - and as an apprentice, you’ll work alongside expert engineers and project managers, learning hands‑on skills and knowledge that help power major industries across the UK and beyond. Our Project Manager Apprenticeship gives you real life experience, exposure to a variety of business projects and the chance to build solid technical skills in a professional engineering environment. Key Responsibilities
• Provide day-to-day administrative support to teams or managers
• Assist with creating and updating project plans, schedules, and timelines
• Communicate project updates to stakeholders and team members
• Maintain accurate records, databases, and filing systems
• Input and update information using internal systems and spreadsheets
• Act as a first point of contact for internal and external enquiries
• Communicate professionally via email, phone, and face-to-face
• Support customer or stakeholder queries and escalate where required
• Assist with improving administrative processes and ways of working
• Support business operations such as procurement, invoicing, or project management
• Help monitor KPIs and produce basic performance reports What We’re Looking For We welcome applicants who are enthusiastic about engineering and ready to learn. You’ll be a great fit if you have:
• 3 National 5’s (passes) , including Maths and English
• Motivation to learn and develop new skills
• Good time ‑ management and organisational ability
• A positive, flexible attitude and strong attention to detail
• Prior business administration or project management experience isn’t required - just curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to get involved. What we offer you
• Competitive apprentice pay that increases as you progress
• Mentoring and support from experienced professionals
• Opportunities to work with modern technology and innovative applications
• Sponsored education with pathways to higher qualifications
• Potential short placements at other UK sites
• Opportunities to work with teams or customers internationally
• Strong potential for a permanent role on successful completion
• Long ‑ term development and progression routes within Sulzer
• A UK-wide apprentice community of more than 80 peers
• 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays)
• Company pension scheme What Will Your Time as an Apprentice Look Like? Year 1 – Full‑Time College You’ll spend your first year at college working towards a Level 2 or Level 3 engineering qualification. This gives you the foundation knowledge and core skills you’ll need before joining the team on-site. Years 2, 3 & 4 – On‑Site Development From your second year onwards, you’ll be based within our engineering teams. You’ll gain hands‑on experience, apply what you’ve learned, and continue your studies towards a Level 3 qualification and your final Apprenticeship Standard. Throughout this time you’ll receive regular mentoring, internal training, and opportunities to broaden your experience across different engineering tasks. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Pump Solutions Ireland Ltd is part of our Water and Industry Business Unit which aspires to develop - among others - products and solutions that support water recycling in s sustainable energy efficient way. There are 270 people employed in the Sulzer Company based in Wexford. This role requires the capabilities to design, develop, code, test and debug software of our embedded devices and systems. A key responsibility will be to recommend new approaches, advising on industry standards, and will work closely with hardware specialists and programming teams. We are looking for a/an Embedded Electronic Software Development Engineer to join our FE_Products, Technology and Digitalization team in Ireland. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Technical responsibility for the design of our embedded software (firmware) for control, monitoring and connectivity solutions.
• Specify, design and document technical requirements, and define test plans as appropriate.
• Analyse and enhance efficiency, stability and scalability of our designs.
• Work closely with internal and external resources to ensure work is completed to specification.
• Evaluate and select software components that will be used in larger solutions.
• Manage technical updates to our existing product portfolio.
• Advise on opportunities to streamline our control, monitoring and connected solutions. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Honours Degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or similar with 7+ years of experience in best practices software development, delivery, and deployment.
• In-depth knowledge of C programming languages.Experience in developing firmware for embedded applications.
• Knowledge of software architecture for connected industrial applications/solutions.
• Knowledge of embedded systems with IoT or M2M capability.
• Knowledge of industrial communications protocols (Modbus, CAN, OPC, DNP3,).
• Knowledge of Telecoms/Network communications protocols (TCP/IP, GPRS/3G/4G, Wireless, low energy protocols).
• Experience with version control software.
• Analytical skills for root cause determination.
• Experience of working in a multi-disciplinary and multinational team environment. What we offer you
• Annual Leave - Enjoy 26 days of holiday.
• Pension - Benefit from a defined contribution pension scheme.
• Flextime - Work Life Balance
• Long Service Awards - We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.
• Employee Assistance Programme - Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.
• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities - Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression.
• Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Establish and maintain effective communication with customers and internal teams to enhance customer satisfaction and support informed decision-making.
• Ensure proper project closure through comprehensive documentation, reporting, and formal handover to relevant stakeholders.
• Apply strategic thinking, problem-solving skills, and innovative approaches to resolve project/order execution challenges.
• Demonstrate strong technical and manufacturing process knowledge to effectively collaborate with engineering, production, and operations teams.

• Exhibit excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a top employer and one of the world's leading pump manufacturers. Sulzer provides a wide range of products for pumping solutions for water, oil and gas, power, and chemicals industries. Due to continued growth, we are looking for a Product Development Engineer for the Technology Center in Thimister/Belgium. This is a fantastic opportunity for you to focus on the development and standardization of products with our teams globally. As the Product Development Engineer, you will be given the opportunity to work on innovative projects ranging from design activities to product enhancement activities. If you are talented Mechanical Engineer who is enthusiastic, self-motivated and have a passion to produce high quality engineering, we would love to hear from you! We offer you interesting and challenging tasks in a global, multi-cultural environment. This is your chance to join a leading organization, contributing to a cutting-edge initiative, and make a real impact on the future success of Sulzer. Location: We are based in Thimister-Clermont, Belgium. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Responsible for the Product Development project activities and for achieving the project objectives.
• Design activities such as the creation of design studies, master assemblies and detailed drawings, including related design calculations.
• Coordinate detailed design drawing activities globally.
• Standardize key design features for the product range.
• Create and maintain product documentation such as design catalogues, hydraulic performance curves, product manuals and tools.
• Utilize current technologies, develop tools and methods to control designs.
• Effective communication with manufacturing entities and Product Management global organization to ensure a collaborative approach. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A degree in Mechanical Engineering with 4+ years’ industry experience
• Fluency in English and French
• Strong collaboration skills within a global, multicultural environment
• Proficiency in 2D and 3D CAD tools (e.g. NX, SolidWorks)
• A customer-focused mindset with the ability to translate technical needs into solutions
• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
• High level of accuracy and attention to detail What we offer you
• Continuous development opportunities, with full access to the Sulzer Learning Platform to support your personal and professional growth
• 36 days of annual leave
• A comprehensive pension and group insurance scheme designed to support your long-term security
• Private health insurance for you and your family

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un tecnico/tecnico di laboratorio per unire il nostro team di applicazioni e tecnologie in Allschwil. In questo ruolo emozionante si pianifica ed eseguirà le prove dei clienti, nonché il supporto attivo sui progetti di ricerca e sviluppo interni (R&D). Condurrai diversi lavori pratici nel campo R&D per migliorare la sostenibilità nell'industria chimica e sviluppare le tecnologie future. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Analisi della caratterizzazione mediante tecniche chiave, tra cui: cromatografia a gas (GC) con campionamento a testa e liquido accoppiato a rilevatori di MS, FID e TCD; spettroscopia ottica a emissione plasmatica ad alte prestazioni (ICP-OES); spettrofotometria UV-Viss; spettrofotometria a scansione differenziale
• Responsabile del supporto analitico, garantendo l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione dei metodi e dell'operabilità dei dispositivi corrispondenti durante le prove (compresa la preparazione degli strumenti, la calibrazione esterna, la preparazione dei campioni e le misurazioni di routine)
• Pianificazione, esecuzione, valutazione e rendicontazione delle prove del cliente (scala del banco a scala pilota).
• Supporto nell'esecuzione di prove interne ed esterne per lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione delle tecnologie Sulzer;
• Lavoro in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali interni;
• Assicurare e rispettare adeguate misure di ESH e "buona pratica di laboratorio" durante il commercio quotidiano. Contribuire attivamente alla gestione dei cambiamenti e delle valutazioni dei rischi. Rispetta le norme di sicurezza e le procedure di qualità, segnala le mancanze, gli incidenti e gli incidenti. Considerare gli aspetti LEAN al lavoro.
• Suggerire e implementare miglioramenti nel laboratorio analitico;
• Supporto e partecipazione alla distribuzione della strategia di digitalizzazione Technology & Innovation (T&I). Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Diploma di laboratorio / tecnico chimico (apprendistato, diploma tecnico)
• 3-5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile
• Ottimo inglese. Tedesco e francese sono un bene
• Buona conoscenza tecnica nella chimica analitica è essenziale
• Altamente competente con vari strumenti e tecniche come GC (MS, FID e TCD), HPLC (UV e RI), ICP-OES, spettrofotometro UV-VIS, titolazione e misura di proprietà fisiche come densità e viscosità
• Consapevolezza per la gestione sicura di sostanze chimiche, materiali e attrezzature potenzialmente pericolosi
• Grande giocatore di squadra, forti capacità di comunicazione, forte capacità organizzativa, molto indipendente, flessibile, affidabile, orientata al cliente e adattabile. Cosa ti offriamo

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil. In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.
• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)
• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).
• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;
• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;
• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.
• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;
• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)
• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role
• Excellent English. German and French are an asset
• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential
• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity
• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment
• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture
• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Sur le rôle Nous sommes à la recherche d'un technicien de laboratoire / technicien en chimie pour rejoindre notre équipe Applications & Technologies à Allschwil. Dans ce rôle passionnant, vous planifierez et exécuterez des essais clients ainsi qu'un soutien actif pour des projets internes de recherche et développement (R-D). • Soutien à la réalisation d'essais internes et externes pour le développement et l'optimisation des technologies Sulzer;
• travailler en étroite collaboration avec les acteurs internes de l'entreprise;
• Assurer et respecter les mesures appropriées d'ESH et les "bonnes pratiques de laboratoire" dans les affaires quotidiennes. Contribuer activement à la gestion des changements et des évaluations des risques. • Proposer et mettre en oeuvre des améliorations dans le laboratoire d'analyse;
• Soutenir et participer au déploiement de la stratégie de numérisation de la technologie et de l'innovation. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devrez :
• Diplôme de laboratoire/technicien en chimie (apprentissage, diplôme technique)
• 3-5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire
• Excellent anglais. L'allemand et le français sont un atout
• Une bonne connaissance technique de la chimie analytique est essentielle
• Très compétent avec divers instruments et techniques tels que GC (MS, FID et TCD), HPLC (UV et RI), ICP-OES, spectrophotomètre UV-VIS, titrage et mesure des propriétés physiques telles que la densité et la viscosité
• Sensibilisation à la manipulation sécuritaire des produits chimiques, des matières et du matériel potentiellement dangereux
• Grand joueur d'équipe, fortes compétences en communication, forte capacité d'organisation, très indépendante, flexible, digne de confiance, orientée client et adaptable. Ce que nous vous offrons
• Indemnité attrayante et plan de vacances
• Excellents avantages sociaux
• Possibilités de développement mondial
• Une culture innovante, dynamique et agile

• Prix de longue durée Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for comprehensive understanding project scope to determine the requirement for developing a Submittal Package. Submittal package includes mechanical design, General Arrangement (GA) drawings and the preparation of mechanical components specific to individual sales orders. The role involves compiling and coordinating the development of Submittal Packages in close collaboration with Motor Control Designers and the ORE Manager. Additionally, this position will manage the submittal approval process with customers, ensuring timely feedback and resolution. Upon approval, the position is accountable for generating fabrication drawings, creating part numbers within the ERP system, and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, the position provides mechanical engineering expertise to Tendering by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
• Review project scope and specifications and organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.
• Design mechanical components, assemblies, and general arrangement drawings specific to sales orders using Autodesk Inventor and maintain associated files within the Autodesk Vault management system.
• Create and manage submittal packages through the customer approval process, ensuring timely and accurate release.
• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the Visual ERP system.
• Review and verify mechanical drawings and bills of materials (BOMs) prepared by other team members within the ORE department to ensure accuracy and compliance.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion. Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:
• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service
• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service
• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service
• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program. Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path. Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities: Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX. All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements). Functions
• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.
• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.
• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.
• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects. Skills

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Riepilogo del lavoro Sulzer Pump Services è alla ricerca di un Supply Chain Manager per gestire 12 sedi a livello nazionale. Sarai responsabile dell'impostazione, del supporto e del miglioramento continuo della linea di prodotti Pump Services e del relativo programma di gestione della catena di fornitura.
• Identificare e gestire i rapporti con i fornitori, negoziare i contratti e garantire l'acquisizione tempestiva di materie prime e componenti.
• Coordinare il trasporto, lo stoccaggio e lo stoccaggio delle merci per garantire che raggiungano le loro destinazioni in modo efficiente ed economico.
• Mantenere adeguati livelli di scorte di materiali e prodotti finiti, analizzare i dati di inventario e garantire che siano disponibili scorte sufficienti per la produzione e gli ordini dei clienti.
• Prevedere la domanda, pianificare i programmi di produzione e coordinarsi con i team di produzione per allineare la produzione alle esigenze del mercato.
• Costruire e mantenere solide relazioni con fornitori, produttori, distributori e clienti per garantire una collaborazione fluida e affrontare i problemi.
• Revisione e analisi continua delle funzioni e dei processi logistici esistenti per identificare aree di miglioramento e sviluppare politiche per aumentare l'efficienza.
• Identificazione e implementazione di strategie per ridurre al minimo i costi lungo tutta la catena di fornitura, dall'approvvigionamento alla consegna.
• Semplificazione dei processi e ottimizzazione dell'allocazione delle risorse per aumentare la produzione e migliorare le prestazioni operative complessive.
• Garantire una consegna puntuale e affidabile dei prodotti ai clienti, il che contribuisce a un'esperienza positiva per il cliente.
• Utilizzo di dati e analisi sulle prestazioni per prendere decisioni informate e guidare strategie di miglioramento.
• Identificare potenziali problemi all'interno della catena di fornitura, come interruzioni della fornitura o picchi improvvisi della domanda, e sviluppare strategie per mitigare questi rischi. Qualifiche:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o titolo tecnico simile OPPURE
• Laurea in economia relativa alla catena di fornitura, gestione dei fornitori, analisi aziendale
• 5 anni di esperienza nel settore manifatturiero con responsabilità di gestione della catena di fornitura e analisi aziendale
• Responsabilità P&L di almeno 5 anni Cosa ti offriamo
• 15 giorni di ferie retribuite e 12 ferie retribuite dall'azienda
• Piano 401k con una corrispondenza del 6%
• Piano sanitario completo che include cure mediche, odontoiatriche, oculistiche, vita, a breve termine e disabilità a lungo termine
• Integrazione del conto di risparmio sanitario
• Programma benessere motivante
• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Congedo paterno retribuito
• Rimborso palestra Sulzer è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Sulzer Pump Services is looking for a Supply Chain Manager to manage 12 locations nationwide. You will be responsible for setting up, supporting, and continuous improvement of the Pump Services Product Line and its supply chain management program.
• Identifying and managing relationships with suppliers, negotiating contracts, and ensuring the timely acquisition of raw materials and components.
• Coordinating the transportation, warehousing, and storage of goods to ensure they reach their destinations efficiently and cost-effectively.
• Maintaining appropriate stock levels of materials and finished products, analyzing inventory data, and ensuring enough supplies are available for production and customer orders.
• Forecasting demand, planning production schedules, and coordinating with manufacturing teams to align output with market needs.
• Building and maintaining strong relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, distributors, and customers to ensure smooth collaboration and address issues.
• Continuously reviewing and analyzing existing logistical functions and processes to identify areas for improvement and developing policies to increase efficiency.
• Identifying and implementing strategies to minimize costs throughout the supply chain, from sourcing to delivery.
• Streamlining processes and optimizing resource allocation to increase output and improve overall operational performance.
• Ensuring timely and reliable delivery of products to customers, which contributes to a positive customer experience.
• Utilizing performance data and analytics to make informed decisions and guide strategies for improvement.
• Identifying potential issues within the supply chain, such as supply disruptions or sudden spikes in demand, and developing strategies to mitigate these risks. Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or similar technical degree OR
• Bachelor’s degree in business relevant to supply chain, vendor management, business analysis
• 5 Years relevant experience in manufacturing with supply chain management and business analysis responsibilities
• Minimum of 5- year P&L responsibility What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym re-imbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Stellenübersicht Sulzer Pump Services sucht einen Supply Chain Manager für die Leitung von 12 Standorten im ganzen Land. Sie sind für die Einrichtung, Unterstützung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Pump Services-Produktlinie und ihres Lieferkettenmanagementprogramms verantwortlich.
• Identifizieren und Verwalten von Beziehungen zu Lieferanten, Aushandeln von Verträgen und Sicherstellen der rechtzeitigen Beschaffung von Rohstoffen und Komponenten.
• Koordinierung des Transports, der Lagerung und der Lagerung von Waren, um sicherzustellen, dass sie ihr Ziel effizient und kostengünstig erreichen.
• Aufrechterhaltung angemessener Lagerbestände an Materialien und Fertigprodukten, Analyse der Bestandsdaten und Sicherstellung, dass genügend Vorräte für die Produktion und Kundenaufträge verfügbar sind.
• Prognose der Nachfrage, Planung von Produktionsplänen und Koordination mit Fertigungsteams, um die Produktion an die Marktbedürfnisse anzupassen.
• Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu Lieferanten, Herstellern, Händlern und Kunden, um eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit sicherzustellen und Probleme anzugehen.
• Kontinuierliche Überprüfung und Analyse bestehender logistischer Funktionen und Prozesse, um Bereiche mit Verbesserungspotenzial zu identifizieren und Richtlinien zur Effizienzsteigerung zu entwickeln.
• Identifizieren und Umsetzen von Strategien zur Kostenminimierung in der gesamten Lieferkette, von der Beschaffung bis zur Lieferung.
• Rationalisierung von Prozessen und Optimierung der Ressourcenzuteilung, um den Output zu steigern und die Gesamtbetriebsleistung zu verbessern.
• Sicherstellung einer pünktlichen und zuverlässigen Lieferung der Produkte an die Kunden, was zu einem positiven Kundenerlebnis beiträgt.
• Nutzung von Leistungsdaten und Analysen, um fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und Verbesserungsstrategien zu entwickeln.
• Identifizierung potenzieller Probleme innerhalb der Lieferkette, wie etwa Lieferunterbrechungen oder plötzliche Nachfragespitzen, und Entwicklung von Strategien zur Minderung dieser Risiken. Qualifikationen:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder einem ähnlichen technischen Abschluss ODER
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft mit Bezug zu Lieferkette, Lieferantenmanagement und Geschäftsanalyse
• 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Fertigung mit Verantwortung für Lieferkettenmanagement und Geschäftsanalyse
• Mindestens 5-jährige Gewinn- und Verlustverantwortung Was wir Ihnen bieten
• 15 Tage bezahlte Freistellung und 12 vom Unternehmen bezahlte Feiertage
• 401k-Plan mit einer 6-prozentigen Ergänzung
• Umfassender Krankenversicherungsplan, einschließlich medizinischer, zahnärztlicher, Sehkraft-, Lebens-, Kurzzeit- und Langzeitinvalidität
• Angleichung des Gesundheitssparkontos
• Motivierendes Wellnessprogramm
• Mitarbeiterhilfsprogramm
• Bezahlter Vaterschaftsurlaub
• Erstattung der Kosten für das Fitnessstudio Sulzer ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten. Wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den USA als Top-Arbeitgeber 2026 ausgezeichnet zu werden.
