descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Augmentez votre carrière grâce à une opportunité nouvellement créée chez Sulzer, alors que nous développons une capacité de vente, d'inventaire et de planification des opérations (SiOP) au sein de notre division Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). La RPP met l'accent sur l'entretien et l'amélioration des équipements rotatifs essentiels dans les industries comme l'énergie, l'eau et la fabrication. L'exploitation dans un environnement dynamique de marché secondaire signifie que la demande est moins prévisible et que les projets impliquent souvent une ingénierie sur mesure ou inverse, rendant la planification plus complexe — et bien plus intéressante — que dans un contexte de fabrication traditionnel. En tant qu'analyste commercial de l'inventaire des ventes et de la planification des opérations, vous aiderez à façonner cette capacité à partir de la base, en conduisant la prise de décision axée sur les données à travers les équipes au Royaume-Uni, en Europe et en Afrique. Vous connecterez plusieurs systèmes, améliorant la visibilité et permettant une planification plus alignée et tournée vers l'avenir. En travaillant avec Salesforce, SAP, D365 et Qlik Sense, Tagetik et d'autres systèmes, vous transformerez des données complexes en informations claires et exploitables qui soutiennent les décisions opérationnelles et stratégiques dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Ce que vous ferez
• Analyser les tendances de la demande à l'aide de données CRM, en partenariat étroit avec les équipes Ventes, Service et Appel d'offres
• Combiner les données internes sur les performances et les perspectives du marché extérieur pour éclairer la planification de la demande
• Évaluer les données relatives à l'offre dans plusieurs entités manufacturières, en identifiant les risques et les possibilités
• Concevoir et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord et des rapports qui offrent une visibilité sur l'ensemble des pipelines de vente et des plans opérationnels
• Traduire les données en mesures et visualisations significatives pour améliorer les prévisions et le suivi des performances
• Présenter des points de vue et des recommandations dans les examens mensuels des PON, les actions de pilotage et l'amélioration continue
• Établir et améliorer la gouvernance des données, la cohérence et les meilleures pratiques entre les systèmes;
• Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle avec Finance, Opérations et Ventes – aligner les équipes autour d'une seule version de la vérité Ce que nous cherchons
• Expérience éprouvée (c.5+ années) dans un rôle d'analyse, de préférence dans l'ingénierie des ateliers, la fabrication ou l'environnement de service (mais pas nécessaire).
• Forte expérience avec les outils BI (Power BI et / ou Qlik Sense), avec la capacité de construire des tableaux de bord impactés
• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP/CRM (par exemple SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte capacité de modélisation des données et d'Excel
• Un état d'esprit curieux et résolvant les problèmes avec la capacité de repérer les tendances et de contester les hypothèses
• Compétences en gestion des parties prenantes avec une expérience influant sur l'ensemble des fonctions
• Travail confortable dans un environnement rapide et moins structuré où vous pouvez façonner les processus, pas seulement les suivre
• Volonté de voyager occasionnellement dans la région de l'EMEA Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un rôle entièrement isolé à domicile avec des déplacements occasionnels entre les régions.
• Un salaire de base compétitif
• Régime annuel de primes personnelles basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle
• Assurance médicale privée
• 33 jours de congé annuel.
• Cotisations définies.
• L'accès à Medicash vous aide à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.
• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.
• L'accès à des réductions sur le style de vie de divertissement shopping plus la possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.
• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.
• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.
• Des possibilités d'apprentissage continu grâce aux voies d'apprentissage Sulzer.
• En tant que titulaire du Prix Bronze du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la défense, nous accueillons et soutenons les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes volontaires dans des politiques d'entraînement, de camps et de déploiement, ainsi qu'un réseau militaire interne croissant. Sulzer

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Leeds Service Centre. This is a pivotal, leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Leeds service centre brings together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating equipment. Supporting customers across key sectors including power generation, renewables, water, and general industry, the team is focused on reliability, innovation, and delivering strong customer outcomes. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Own the P&L for the Leeds Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.
• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.
• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.
• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.
• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.
• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).
• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.
• Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly, both within and across the wider regional operations organisation. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across in an Service / Aftermarket / Industrial Engineering environment
• Experience in business management and P&L ownership,
• A track record of driving transformation, growth, or organisational change.
• Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements.
• LEAN/Continuous Improvement experience (desirable).
• NEBOSH qualification (desirable). What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• An annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and your individual contribution
• Private Medical Insurance
• Car / Car Allowance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a dynamic Accounts Payable Coordinator to join our Finance & Accounting team in Polanco, Mexico. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with international and external stakeholders, leverage your expertise in accounts payable. If you enjoy creating impact and eager to advance your career within a global and mission-led organization, we want to hear from you! In this position you will be a member of our Accounts Payable Controls team based in our Mexico office. You will work together with an external shared service center who is responsible for master data, invoice processing and payments. Furthermore, you will closely work other country Finance functions, Procurement, and external vendors. Key Responsibilities
• Independently manage the daily business in accounts payable, in collaboration with the country’s Finance team and the external Shared Service Center
• Manage escalations in incoming accounts payable related queries from suppliers SULZER CONFIDENTIAL
• Review payment proposals and ensure a complete alignment with the country’s compliance requirements.
• Monitor and control accounts payable aging.
• Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements according to IFRS.
• Drive process standardization and reduce inefficiencies, acting as a guide for the shared services teams.
• Actively support various projects, such as system implementations and process optimizations. Skills & Qualifications
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related fields
• 4 years of experience in Accounts Payable
• Very good written and verbal communication skills
• Knowledge of ERP systems (preferable SAP or D365)
• Fluent English skills
• Analytical and problem-solving skills What we offer you
• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )
• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching
• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition
• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)
• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance
• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving. A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference. We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities
• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes
• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures
• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding
• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers
• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time Job Qualifications
• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)
• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors
• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings
• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• Paid overtime opportunities
• Annual companywide bonus
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving. • Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures
• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding
• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers

• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)
• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors
• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tendering Manager is responsible for managing a team of professionals in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals. This role ensures the accuracy and competitiveness of tenders and supports the sales process with technical expertise. 1. Deputizing for Regional Sales Director where appropriate 2. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines 3. Mentoring, directing, motivating, supervising, and monitoring the performance of all members of the allocated team 4. Identify and initiate department training on a regular basis 5. Day to day review of enquiries in conjunction with the Regional Sales Director 6. Support, assist and initiate new client contract agreements as and when identified 7. Allocation of enquiries to the tendering resource ensuring optimum use of that resource in all groups. 8. Provide support during the pre-tender process starting from evaluating/assessing tenders, assessing risk factors to arrive at bid decisions, and estimating all the required material, equipment, and manpower needs to be able to arrive at reliable cost estimates for bidding spares, service to turnkey projects. 9. Study, analyze and evaluate tender documents and identify risk factors, ensure that technical terms comply with the relevant standards and coordinates with the Division Heads, and Regional Sales Director for the overall risk assessment and bid decision. 10. Overall responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst meeting SPZA targets 11. Overall responsibility to ensure that tenders for PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE meet company commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the delegation of authority guidelines 12. Overall responsibility together with the Regional Sales Director for maintaining the profit margin on SPZA tenders 13. Proactively engage with procurement to ensure competitive bidding is possible 14. Review and finalize project cost estimates as prepared by the Tendering Engineer in terms of the required material as per bill of quantities (BOQ), amount of work, material/ equipment/ and manpower requirements during the tendering phase; this includes all systems, products and services to client specifications/ requirements. 15. Finalize estimation of all direct and indirect costs and consolidate tender documents for management review and approval. 16. Ensure in conjunction with sales that the Preliminary eTOA and eTOA tool is utilized in line with the eTOA regulation requirements for tenders meeting this criteria 17. Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time 18. Overall responsibility to ensure that Order Entry Documentation is completed in accordance with handover guidelines and procedures and company KPIs. 19. Ensure tender margins are accurate for order entry. 20. Overall responsibility to ensure that the sales team are adequately supported and that projects are launched in a timely and professional manner 21. Ensure that handover meetings with projects are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status 22. Provide all the necessary project clarifications/ information upon project award to the Project Manager as per the project budget; advises the Project Manager on contractual rights, remedies which has been taken into consideration during tendering. 23. Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement. 24. All other duties as relevant to the post. 
• Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required  Relevant experience within related

About the role Welds, fabricates and reconditions components and parts to customers, OEM and industry standards using basic oxy-acetylene brazing techniques, shielded metal arc, gas metal arc, gas tungsten arc, submerged arc and other resistance welding operations. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Sulzer Turbo Services is seeking a skilled Machine Tool Technician to support maintenance, repair, and operation of precision machining equipment used in the repair and servicing of turbomachinery components. This role is responsible for ensuring machine tools operate safely, efficiently, and within required tolerances to support high-quality manufacturing and repair operations. Key Responsibilities
• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.
• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.
• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.
• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.
• Support production teams to minimize downtime.
• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.
• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.
• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.
• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.
• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.
• Complete all company-required training programs. Required Qualifications
• High School Diploma or GED required.
• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.
• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.
• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.
• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.
• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and within a team environment. Preferred Skills
• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.
• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.
• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.
• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred. Physical Requirements
• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.
• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment. Work Environment
• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.
• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.
• PPE required at all times. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.
• Support production teams to minimize downtime.
• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.
• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.
• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and within a team environment. Preferred Skills

• Engagement fort des parties prenantes et influence les compétences

• Read job cards to determine; job status, work authorization/limitations, estimate, description of problems and/or expected serviceability.
• Test electro-mechanical equipment to troubleshoot known or suspected problems using various methods (ac or de).

• Complete required paperwork for each job accurately and on a timely basis.

• Observe all safety procedures and use proper protective gear (especially eye and car protection).
• Lift, tighten, adjust and/or secure heavy objects in order to perform work duties.

• Assisted other mechanics or other shop personnel in skilled or –non-skilled duties as directed by supervisor or shop manager.
• Perform other skilled or not-skilled duties as directed by supervisor QUALIFICATIONS
• High school diploma or equivalent

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Product Manager per modellare il futuro di Industrial Water Treatment Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions è un luogo in cui le menti imprenditoriali crescono. Stiamo cercando un Product Manager per Industrial Treatm ent Solutions per modellare le ambizioni di crescita nel trattamento, un talento che è pronto a prendere la proprietà e fare un impatto reale. Stiamo ora cercando un Product Manager proattivo e focalizzato sul cliente per portare le nostre tecnologie globali collaudate in nuovi mercati regionali. In questo ruolo, si possiede l'adattamento e il lancio dei prodotti esistenti in offerte orientate a soluzioni locali. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team globali e regionali, guiderai i trasferimenti tecnologici, localizzerai i prodotti alle esigenze di mercato e di regolamentazione, e garantirai la piena disponibilità commerciale tra vendite, operazioni e supporto alle applicazioni. Definirai la strategia regionale dei prodotti, insieme ai team locali che daranno informazioni sul mercato, coprendo le esigenze dei clienti, la concorrenza, i prezzi e le normative. Da questo, si costruirà una roadmap focalizzata, business case e KPI, regolare i corsi dove necessario. Potrai condurre la soluzione lancia, modellare proposizioni di valore e prezzi, e consentire ai team di vendita attraverso formazione, strumenti e supporto hands-on. Essendo un esperto di applicazioni di prodotto, lavorerai a stretto contatto con i clienti e gli specialisti interni, supportano i piloti e le implementazioni anticipate e trasformano il feedback in miglioramenti continui dei prodotti. Sei un auto-avviamento con forti capacità di comunicazione e una solida comprensione del trattamento delle acque industriali o soluzioni tecniche simili. L'esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nell'ingegneria dei processi, nello sviluppo aziendale o nelle vendite in un'organizzazione internazionale di matrice è altamente apprezzata. Fluency in inglese e la volontà di viaggiare sono necessari. A Sulzer, troverete un ruolo con reale influenza, varie sfide e spazio per crescere.
• Offriamo un ambiente collaborativo che valorizza innovazione, collaborazione e risultati. Questo ruolo si trova vicino a un ufficio di Sulzer in Europa e preferibilmente in Spagna, Italia, Germania o Francia. Per domande, si prega di contattare il responsabile di reclutamento Erik Edvardsson su erik . edvardsson @sulzer.com Si prega di osservare che questo è un processo di reclutamento in corso e che la posizione potrebbe essere riempita prima della data di chiusura dell'annuncio. Cosa ti offriamo TBD Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Teknisk orderadminstratör Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB, Mölndal Teknisk orderadminstratör Hos oss skapas möjligheter att växa – nu söker vi en teknisk orderadministratör efter att tjänsten blivit ledig genom intern utveckling och karriär. Är du engagerad, noggrann, uppskattar adminstrativa uppgifter och dessutom har tekniskt intresse läs vidare, du kanske är den vi söker? Vi söker ytterligare en medarbetare till vårt orderteam i Mölndal, med fokus på att stötta våra kommun, industri och energi – kunder på den svenska marknaden. Sulzer utvecklar och tillverkar innovativa lösningar av högsta kvalitet och med senaste teknik inom pumpning, omrörning, luftning och service. Med en egen fabrik i Sverige samt tillgång till ett globalt nätverk av fabriker inom Sulzer erbjuder rollen daglig kontakt och ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, både nationellt och globalt. Du blir en del av ett större order- och offertteam bestående av totalt tio personer, varav hälften arbetar med order- och reservdelshantering, där vi nu söker en ny kollega. Tjänsten har ett tekniskt administrativt fokus med daglig kundkontakt och nära dialog med säljorganisationen. Det här kommer du att arbeta med: I rollen arbetar du med att ta emot och hantera förfrågningar på reservdelar, ta fram offerter samt föra dialog med kunder. Du ansvarar för att lägga in reservdels- och produktorder i SAP, vilket inkluderar konfigurering av produkter utifrån tekniska offerter – från enstaka order till större projekt. Arbetet innebär löpande kontakt med våra producerande enheter internationellt avseende bland annat orderstatus och leveranser. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water Nordic Water avser nu tillsätta en nya tjänst, Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water tjänsten är baserade på vårt centralkontor i Göteborg Sulzer - Nordic Water Products AB, utvecklar, tillverkar och levererar maskiner och utrustning för vatten- och avloppsvattenrening. Vi har många års erfarenhet och är världsledande inom flera av våra specialområden med produkter såsom DynaSand kontinuerliga sandfilter, Johnson lamellseparator, DynaDisc skivfilter, DynaCloth fiberdiscfilter, DynaBelt bandfilter MevaScreen galler- & rensutrustning samt Zickert slamskrapor. Vi erbjuder såväl enskilda maskinkomponenter som integrerade system och lösningar. Vi har centralkontor i Göteborg samt kontor och serviceenheter i Mariestad, Helsingborg och Fjärås (Kungsbacka). Våra produkter säljs över hela världen genom ett nätverk av egna kontor, representanter och återförsäljare. Nordic Water Sverige omsätter ca 600 miljoner SEK och har ca 100 anställda. Vi erbjuder nu en tjänst med stora möjligheter att själv påverka arbetssätt och rutiner, och det lämnar stort utrymme för eget ansvar och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Som process & applikationsspecialist på Nordic Water kommer du att ingå i vårt kommersiella processdesign- team. Tjänsten är en specialist-tjänst inom produktsegmentet VA-process. Avdelningens huvudsakliga uppgifter är att svara för en fördjupad produkt- och process- & applikations kompetens inom produktområdet, och ge såväl kommersiell som produktorienterad support till den globala säljorganisationen. Fördjupad teknisk expertis, framtagning av nya dimensioneringverktyg samt processrelaterad applikationsguider utifrån företagets produkter och system till projekt över hela värden upptar stor del av arbetsuppgifterna i gruppen. Du kommer att arbeta på kontoret i Göteborg, men resor inom Sverige och internationellt kan förekomma. Flera av projekten kan vara mer av karaktären systemleveranser och därmed tekniskt komplexa, därför ser vi gärna att du har en god känsla för teamwork, samarbete och är utåtriktad.
• Projektleda, planera och genomföra strategiska undersökningar som utgör grunden för nya designverktyg för våra befintliga och nya produkter och applikationer.
• Verifiering och testning av dessa prov i fält (nationellt och utomlands)
• Ansvarig för datainsamling, samt bearbetning av stora dataserier slutsatser och presentation i detaljerade professionella rapporter. Ledarskap, affärsdriven problemlösning och utveckling är något som vi ser den sökande finner stort intresse av. För att lyckas i tjänsten ser vi gärna att du har:
• Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, eller högre akademisk utbildning inom kemi eller likvärdig
• Gärna goda VA-kunskaper eller erfarenhet av liknande verksamhet är meriterande
• Teknikintresse och gärna praktisk/teoretisk erfarenhet.
• Initiativrik med kommersiellt sinne för teknisk problemlösning
• Strukturerad och har förmåga att självständigt leda och ta ansvar för och lösa komplexa uppgifter.
• Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift, övriga språk är meriterande.
• Körkort För ytterligare information och ansökan om tjänsten som Senior VA-process & applikations specialist , kontakta Mattias Feldthusen, Director Products +46 704 202156 E-post: mattias.feldthusen@sulzer.com Tjänsten skall tillsättas omgående och vi vill därför ha din ansökan snarast. What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportu

Vi erbjuder nu en tjänst med stora möjligheter att själv påverka arbetssätt och rutiner, och det lämnar stort utrymme för eget ansvar och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Som process & applikationsspecialist på Nordic Water kommer du att ingå i vårt kommersiella processdesign- team. Tjänsten är en specialist-tjänst inom produktsegmentet VA-process. Avdelningens huvudsakliga uppgifter är att svara för en fördjupad produkt- och process- & applikations kompetens inom produktområdet, och ge såväl kommersiell som produktorienterad support till den globala säljorganisationen. Fördjupad teknisk expertis, framtagning av nya dimensioneringverktyg samt processrelaterad applikationsguider utifrån företagets produkter och system till projekt över hela värden upptar stor del av arbetsuppgifterna i gruppen. Du kommer att arbeta på kontoret i Göteborg, men resor inom Sverige och internationellt kan förekomma. Flera av projekten kan vara mer av karaktären systemleveranser och därmed tekniskt komplexa, därför ser vi gärna att du har en god känsla för teamwork, samarbete och är utåtriktad.
• Projektleda, planera och genomföra strategiska undersökningar som utgör grunden för nya designverktyg för våra befintliga och nya produkter och applikationer.
• Verifiering och testning av dessa prov i fält (nationellt och utomlands)
• Ansvarig för datainsamling, samt bearbetning av stora dataserier slutsatser och presentation i detaljerade professionella rapporter. Ledarskap, affärsdriven problemlösning och utveckling är något som vi ser den sökande finner stort intresse av. För att lyckas i tjänsten ser vi gärna att du har:
• Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, eller högre akademisk utbildning inom kemi eller likvärdig
• Gärna goda VA-kunskaper eller erfarenhet av liknande verksamhet är meriterande
• Teknikintresse och gärna praktisk/teoretisk erfarenhet.
• Initiativrik med kommersiellt sinne för teknisk problemlösning
• Strukturerad och har förmåga att självständigt leda och ta ansvar för och lösa komplexa uppgifter.
• Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift, övriga språk är meriterande.
• Körkort För ytterligare information och ansökan om tjänsten som Senior VA-process & applikations specialist , kontakta Mattias Feldthusen, Director Products +46 704 202156 E-post: mattias.feldthusen@sulzer.com Tjänsten skall tillsättas omgående och vi vill därför ha din ansökan snarast. What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportu

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in the design and manufacture of pumps and associated equipment for some of the world’s most critical industries. Founded in 1834 and headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 13,500 people worldwide, operating in more than 40 countries, generating annual sales of approximately CHF 3.6 billion. Our pumping technologies support customers across the energy, water and wastewater, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, life sciences and food markets, enabling safe, reliable and efficient fluid handling in demanding applications. The Wexford site is a key contributor to Sulzer’s global pumping portfolio, with a strong focus on product development and engineering support for pumps and associated mechanical equipment. The team works closely with international stakeholders, supporting the design and development of products supplied to customers across global markets About the Role & Opportunity We are seeking a Mechanical Design Technician to join our Product Development team in Wexford. This role plays an important part in supporting the design and development of engineered pump solutions and related equipment, working closely with experienced Project Manager's. You will be involved throughout the design lifecycle, contributing to products that are used worldwide in process‑critical environments. This is a development‑focused role within a structured engineering organisation, offering long‑term technical growth and progression opportunities. Key Duties
• Create and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for pumps and associated mechanical equipment
• Produce detailed manufacturing drawings, assemblies and bills of materials
• Support engineering change requests, design updates and product improvements
• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, testing and quality teams
• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, procedures and documentation requirements What We’re Looking For
• A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline
• Experience creating engineering drawings and CAD models within a mechanical or manufacturing environment
• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, components and technical documentation
• A structured, detail‑orientated approach with good communication skills
• Motivation to learn, develop and build a long‑term career within engineering What we offer you
• Competitive base salary
• Annual Leave: Enjoy 26 days of holiday
• Flexibility: Flexible Working Arrangements
• Pension: Benefit from a Defined Contribution Pension Scheme
• On site parking
• Subsidised Canteen on site
• Maternity / Paternity Leave Top Up
• EV Charging on site (At a reduced rate)
• Long Service Award: We acknowledge and celebrate your dedicated years of service.
• Employee Assistance Programme: Prioritise well-being with confidential support and guidance.
• Professional Growth and Development Opportunities: Access to continuous learning and development programs, providing employees with valuable opportunities for skill enhancement and career progression. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Sales Director is responsible for overseeing sales operations within a large region or division, ensuring alignment with business goals and driving revenue growth. This role leads sales teams, manages key accounts, and supports strategic planning. This job profile is intended for senior leaders that support the mid to long-term (3-5 years) strategy development for their functional area, and have ownership of the short to mid-term (1-3 years) execution of functional strategy/operational direction. Requires ability to communicate with and influence executive leadership. Typically manage multiple teams. Main accountabilities and tasks (include KPIs and ESH requirements, if available)
• Regular responsibilities
• Realization of sales objectives by developing existing and new customers
• Expected to frequently travel, i.e. visit customers or relations
• Willingness to follow relevant training courses
• Realization of the objective on order intake and Net Sales (Budget Responsibility)
• Making effective commercial decisions (incl price & profit)
• Ensure a correct translation of customer requirements internally, products and solutions
• Realization of a timely and effective follow-up of the pipeline and quotations
• Initiation and participation in effective customer and order team consultation
• Keeping the relevant customer and project information up-to-date in the systems
• Develop and report forecast as required for OI and Sales
• Continuous evaluation of included risks and opportunities of given FC
• Providing monthly feedback/ input on major activities in our market segments, competitor activities, major orders won or lost etc.
• Responsible for growing sales in the region in line with the Sulzer and WTS 2028 priorities. Ability to develop a plan, execute, and follow up. Use structured deployment methods to ensure clearly defined activities and responsibilities.
• To continually check that our agreed strategy is in line with our customers requirements and market conditions focusing on opportunities where we can achieve a clear number one or two position.
• Key responsibilities:
• Market Conditions
• Voice of Customer
• Strategy Deployment
• Growth Solution sales and follow up
• Market Positioning / Value Add
• Develop the sales organization
• Develop skills to solve customer challenges through application expertise and related technologies
• Ensure utilization and data accuracy in SalesForce and CPQ
• Data accuracy is key and needs to be managed including local policies. Job scope (as applicable, skip irrelevant parameters) Growth focus in stronger market positioning and adding value in solution selling and product sales. Cost optimization, qualified sales channels, increased market penetration. Must be self-initiated and active. Capable to manage multiple open issues at the same time. Key internal / external stakeholders : Working in close cooperation with WTS Management, other regional managers, team leaders, outdoor sales, product- and business development. Relationship to customer (end user, OEM, contractors, or consultant) and their representatives (purchasing, process engineers, engineering offices, etc.): Creating, keeping up and developing good co-operation and negotiations of the best solutions for equipment. Ability to close deals with customers with beneficial circumstances to Sulzer. Decision authority (based on DOA matrix , specific for the job): Educational background
• University degree in Engineering or related field / equivalent education preferred, or
• Proven track record in comparable responsibility within comparable market segment
• High professional use of Microsoft products: Excel, Outlook, Word, etc
• Demonstrable experience with

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Controller is responsible for supporting the financial integrity of the organization through accurate reporting, compliance, and internal controls. This role involves preparing financial statements, assisting with audits, and ensuring adherence to accounting standards and policies. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Key Responsibilities
• Support the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget, providing accurate data and analysis
• Assist in refreshing predictive financial forecasts periodically, ensuring accuracy and relevance
• Help in conducting profitability and performance reporting, providing essential data for decision-making
• Contribute to plan analytics and risk management, assisting in the continuous improvement of financial planning and analysis processes
• Conduct in-depth financial analysis to support business recommendations, under the guidance of senior team members
• Support collections reporting and analytics, ensuring accurate and timely information is available for decision-making
• Provide comprehensive reporting and analytics on procurement activities, aiding informed purchasing decisions
• Help oversee period end close processes, generating accurate and insightful financial reports and analytics
• Assist in period end closing and related analytics, ensuring thorough financial tracking and reporting for projects
• Help oversee CAPEX planning, forecasting, investment strategy, period-end close activities, and reporting
• Support the adherence to International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) in all financial reporting and processes.
• Ensure internal controls are in place for the processes performed by this role
• Comply with relevant QESH regulations Education and experience
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field
• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis or related finance roles
• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is a plus Critical success factors
• Proficiency in financial modelling and forecasting, advanced skills in data analytics and financial software
• Strong understanding of global financial processes and standards
• Strong financial acumen
• Excellent communication skills for delivering key insights to leadership
• Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other stakeholders Technical & language skills
• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus
• Understanding of integrated ERP systems is a plus
• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills
• Proficiency in English What we offer you Medical insurance for self and family Company sponsored transportation facility during week days Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and procuring goods and services required by the organization, including both direct and indirect materials. This role ensures cost-effective purchasing strategies, supplier performance management, and contract administration to support operational efficiency. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. El Especialista en Compras Indirectas será responsable de gestionar el proceso de adquisición de bienes y servicios indirectos, optimizando costos y asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de la empresa. Responsabilidades del Puesto * Identificar, evaluar y seleccionar proveedores para bienes y servicios indirectos (ej. MRO, TI, servicios profesionales, viajes, etc.). * Negociar contratos y acuerdos comerciales con proveedores para obtener las mejores condiciones de precio, calidad y servicio. * Desarrollar y mantener relaciones sólidas con proveedores clave. * Gestionar el ciclo de vida de los contratos, incluyendo revisiones, renovaciones y terminaciones. * Colaborar con los departamentos internos para comprender sus necesidades de adquisición y asegurar la disponibilidad oportuna de los bienes y servicios. * Analizar el gasto en compras indirectas e identificar oportunidades de ahorro y eficiencia. * Garantizar el cumplimiento de las políticas y procedimientos internos de compras, así como las regulaciones externas aplicables. * Mantener actualizados los sistemas de información de compras y la base de datos de proveedores. * Elaborar reportes de desempeño de proveedores y gasto para la toma de decisiones. Cualificaciones del Puesto * Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Comercio Internacional o campo relacionado. * Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en compras indirectas, preferiblemente en un entorno industrial o manufacturero. * Sólidas habilidades de negociación y comunicación. * Dominio del idioma inglés (oral y escrito) indispensable. * Conocimiento avanzado de Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). * Experiencia con sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle o similar) es un plus. * Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y en equipo. * Orientación a resultados y habilidades analíticas. * Conocimiento de las leyes de contratación y regulaciones comerciales. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Machine Operator is responsible for operating and monitoring machinery used in the manufacturing process. This role ensures that machines run efficiently, products meet quality standards, and safety protocols are followed.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Dans le cadre de son activité industrielle, notre entreprise recherche un Technicien d'Usinage (H/F) pour renforcer ses équipes de production.
Vous aurez pour mission principale de réaliser des opérations de tournage et/ou de fraisage sur machines conventionnelles, à commande semi-numérique et numérique, dans le respect des exigences qualité, sécurité et délais.
Vous intervenez sur la fabrication de pièces en lien avec les besoins de production et de développement.

Les activités significatives :

• Préparer la zone de travail ainsi que les équipements nécessaires à la réalisation des pièces

• Analyser les contraintes techniques liées aux pièces à fabriquer

• Lire et interpréter des plans ou schémas techniques mécaniques

• Identifier les différentes phases d’usinage

• Élaborer ou ajuster les programmes et régler les paramètres d’usinage

• Ajuster, monter et modifier les outils de coupe

• Choisir les montages adaptés et régler les machines-outils

• Usiner des pièces unitaires, prototypes ou petites séries en conformité avec les plans et spécifications

• Contrôler la qualité et la conformité des pièces usinées

• Réaliser la maintenance préventive et corrective de premier niveau des équipements

Le profil recherché :

• Formation en usinage / mécanique / productique (CAP, Bac Pro, BTS ou équivalent)

• Expérience sur machines conventionnelles et/ou à commande numérique

• Bonne capacité de lecture de plans mécaniques

• Connaissances en programmation et réglage machines

• Rigueur, précision et sens de la qualité

• Autonomie, esprit d’analyse et respect des consignes de sécurité

What we offer you

Ce que nous vous proposons

• Avantage 1 : Evoluer sur des projets dimensionnants et stratégiques pour le Groupe

• Avantage 2 : Buchelay : référence nucléaire au sein du Groupe SULZER

• Avantage 3 : Avantages d'une "PME" au sein d'un grand Groupe

• Avantage 4 : Accès au Comité Social et Economique (CSE)

• Avantage 5 : Carte Ticket restaurant - Mutuelle Avantageuse - Prime d'intéressement & Participation - RTT

• et bien d'autres...

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This role supports organizations of various sizes and is designed for individuals who enjoy hands‑on technical work, clear documentation, and contributing to high‑quality production and repair processes.
As part of the team, you will be responsible for inspecting, and testing products according to engineering specifications.

A key part of the role involves creating Job Books that guide mechanics on the shop floor, as well as producing 2D assembly forms and repair instructions used during mechanical inspections and repair activities. Once repair work is completed, you will be responsible for digitizing the Job Books to ensure accurate, organized records of all work performed.

Day‑to‑day, you will visually and mechanically inspect finished goods, identify and document any defects, and communicate issues to the appropriate teams. You’ll help maintain production and inspection equipment, follow all safety and quality procedures, and assist with basic troubleshooting or maintenance tasks as needed. Collaboration is important in this role, and you will work closely with team members to meet production goals and support continuous improvement.

To succeed, you should bring strong mechanical and technical aptitude, attention to detail, and comfort reading and following technical instructions or drawings. A high school diploma is required, and 1–2 years of experience working with turbomachinery is preferred. Familiarity with safety, inspection, and quality standards is helpful, along with good communication and teamwork skills. Just as important is a willingness to learn and grow within a manufacturing environment.

Technical proficiency is essential, particularly with AutoCAD and the Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with any 2D or 3D modeling tools—such as Blender, Polyworks, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Maya, or 3ds Max—is also valuable and will support your success in creating clear, accurate documentation.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
The Admin Coordinator is responsible for independently handling administrative tasks and coordinating support activities. This role works autonomously and may guide other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations.
This job profile is intended for professional-level staff that works autonomously and may coordinate the activities of other professional-level staff, especially in non-routine situations. Managing Projects

• Manage the Waterfall Report (backlog) to ensure shipment targets are accurate

• Manage multiple projects/timelines simultaneously, while recognizing dynamic and shifting priorities, and adjusting schedules and deliverables accordingly

• Understanding of project specifications in order to act as an advocate for customer and JWC

• Ensure all projects are delivered on-time, within scope

• Monitor and report on progress of the project to all stakeholders

• Present reports defining project progress, problems and solutions with Order Entry

• Assist customer follow up on outstanding submittals / estimated ship date for waterfall report

• Assist schedule release with customer and production planner

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Health savings account matching

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for reviewing plans, technical specifications and drawings to determine JWC product mix recommendation and pricing to be included in proposals. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
· Effectively respond to the requests and requirements of outside sales team and Consulting Engineers to ensure that current and prospective customers are being communicated consistently on all the Company’s product lines.
· Communicates and follows-up with manufacturer’s representative network to provide specifications and technical sales information to influence Consulting Engineers, contractors and end-user customers.
· Reviews technical specifications and customers’ requirements to determine JWC product mix.
· Completes Formal Quotes and Direct Bids as required.
· Works closely with sales managers, Consulting Engineers to quote and provide correct product mix at a profitable price.
· Follows-up with reps and prospective customers on quotation/proposal status.
· Reviews purchase orders and provide feedback to Contract Administration if terms are unclear or if PO is not valid.
· Resolves customer concerns in a timely manner, understands customer’s needs, applications and specifications.
· Works closely with outside sales staff, R&D and Operations in order to prepare timely and accurate proposals.
· Builds relationships to provide repeat business and excellent customer service.
· Perform other duties and special projects as assigned
Education, Experience & Skills:
Required: Associates Degree in a Technical area or 2 years of related experience
Desirable: CSI specification certification
· 1-2+ years with technical sales, Applications Engineering or Sales Engineering in the North American public works industry. Preferably wastewater treatment industry.
· Excellent oral and written communication skills as well as outstanding overall presentation skills.
· Demonstrated ability to perform equipment take-offs from bid packages.
· Demonstrated ability to read and understand construction drawings and specifications including basic knowledge of motor control electrical schematics
· Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases)
· Highly self-motivated.
· Flexible, reliable, strong work ethic, dependable team player, positive, constructive attitude.
· Outstanding business etiquette skills.
· Knowledge of products and technologies including current and potential applications.

Salary: $75K -90K

What we offer you

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Driven by growth in the FRC business, this role provides focused project delivery, improves cross-functional coordination, and protects margins across advanced turnkey projects ($1M–$5M) . Operating from our Cumming, GA facility, the Senior Project Manager serves as the technical execution hub—collaborating with Mechanical Design, Electrical, and Project Engineering departments to combine resources and deliver complete industrial process systems on time and within budget . Key Responsibilities:
• Synchronize workflows across mechanical design, electrical, and project engineering teams to efficiently output complex systems.
• Travel 30%–40% nationwide to supervise on-site installation work and assist with system commissioning and startup efforts.
• Review, interpret, and resolve discrepancies across technical specifications, customer layout drawings, orders, and P&IDs.
• Prepare engineering submittal documentation and directly address or rectify consulting engineer comments.
• Size, select, and generate purchase requisitions for system components including pumps, piping, tanks, and dosing equipment.
• Maintain sharp cost control, prepare project change orders, review vendor quotes, and negotiate with suppliers.
• Inspect fabricated equipment at manufacturing subcontractor facilities and record strict quality control documentation.
• Maintain close client communication regarding order status and support the sales process by answering technical engineering questions. Skills & Qualifications Minimum Requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Process, Chemical, or Mechanical Engineering (or 15 years of equivalent hands-on engineering experience).
• 6 to 10+ years of progressive project engineering and management experience, specifically within the industrial water and wastewater fields.
• High proficiency in reading P&IDs, checking layout drawings, and working within AutoCAD and standard office suites (Excel/Word).
• Legally authorized to work in the US with the flexibility to travel nationwide 30%–40% of the time
• Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects, make quick decisions under pressure, and manage costs against budgets. Preferred Assets:
• Active PMP certification or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
• Prior experience with wastewater OEM technologies, industrial fluid handling, or onshore/offshore oil and gas process equipment.
• Familiarity with components like Dissolved Air Flotation (DAF) systems, mixers, biological systems, and valves.
• Existing OSHA 30 or OSHA 40 safety certifications (training provided as needed). What we offer you
• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program
• Employee Assistance Program
• Paid paternal leave
• Gym reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities
• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.
• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.
• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.
• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).
• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.
• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.
• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.
• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging equipment. Required Qualifications
• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .
• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.
• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.
• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.
• Must supply basic personal hand tools. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.
• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.
• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.
• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components. Competencies
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.
• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices. What we offer you

• 401k plan with a 6% match

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Riguardo al ruolo Hai scelto un impegno quotidiano e un fiordo importante? Vuoi imparare e imparare ogni giorno sul lavoro? Quali sono le motivazioni che ti spingono ad avere un lavoro di vendita da offrire per rinnovare la tua vita e un ulteriore milione? Som oss vet du at vann ikke bare er en ressurs – det er selve grunnlaget for alt liv. E ottieni qualcosa di più forte di un lavoro con i prestiti che sono sicuri di rendere vannet, trasportatori e fornitori nella migliore maniera possibile. Non stai semplicemente avviando il processo – li vorrai altrimenti. Prendi il controllo della flottazione, del filtraggio meccanico o del lavaggio biologico, quindi sei casa. Hai fatto qualcosa per lavorare e lavorare in anticipo nella carriera e hai visto cosa funziona effettivamente nella pratica – non solo sulla carta. Ma non sei solo esperto della tecnica. Sei un addetto alle relazioni che i tuoi clienti cercano di farcela e rimani sempre davanti a te quando lo prendi. Vendi energia – non perché la selezioni, ma perdi problemi e guadagni soldi per coloro che hanno rubato al tuo tempo faticoso. Stai cercando di fare amicizia con gli uomini e hai un impegno che ti fa battere forte quando presenti o tieni la maschera. Sei un dio nel pianificare la legge, come combinare se stessi con lo samarbeide e padroneggiare le attività digitali come una delle cose naturali di ogni giorno. Un giorno che non ti interessa cercare di chiedere informazioni – nuovo gioco – non sei pronto a farlo. Cos'è questo? Da gleder vi oss til å hore from deg. L'estate ti farà sapere che sei:
• Uno che ha lavorato con le vendite B2B e che ha motivato i clienti simili
• Opta per fare attività ed essere disponibile per i clienti
• Flessibilità e piacere di creare ogni cosa in te stesso
• Self-stendig e reiseglad
• Intelligente, impegno e dio per risolvere i problemi
• Struttura e stile delle forme di comunicazione – la Norvegia è un luogo lavorativo Che cosa pensi di te? E cosa puoi fare per assicurarti? Hos Sulzer ti aiuterà nell'apprendimento continuo e nel mulighetene lo skaper per il tuo tempo libero. Lavori nel team per tornare alle migliori risorse per i tuoi clienti e avrai ingegneri ed esperti nel mondo che ti aiuteranno a farlo. In Norvegia ho Sulzer kontorer e verksteder ad Asker, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand e Trondheim. Abbiamo delle belle pensioni e assicurazioni. Ti offriamo un assortimento flessibile di strumenti di lavoro e leggi tutto per l'uso del conto economico. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. À propos du rôle Résumé du travail Le coordonnateur de l'assurance de la qualité appuie le programme de qualité de l'organisation en examinant la documentation du fournisseur, en maintenant les processus d'étalonnage et en aidant à la vérification, au développement du fournisseur et aux activités de non-conformité. Ce rôle contribue également à l'entretien des procédures, participe aux initiatives EHS et respecte les politiques et les normes de l'entreprise. La réussite de ce poste exige de solides compétences en communication et en organisation, la compétence avec Microsoft Office et SAP, la capacité d'utiliser des M&TE de base et une compréhension de base des procédures de qualité, des spécifications et des codes de l'industrie. FONCTIONS ESSENTIELLES :
• Effectuer des examens de la documentation d'inspection-réception pour vérifier la conformité des fournisseurs aux exigences du bon de commande et à la Liste des fournisseurs approuvés.
• Maintenir et améliorer continuellement le programme d'étalonnage, en mettant l'accent sur la réduction des coûts et la réduction des temps d'arrêt des M&TE pendant l'étalonnage externe.
• Aider à la préparation, à la compilation et à la maintenance de la documentation nécessaire pour répondre aux spécifications de la commande client.
• Appuyer l'élaboration, la révision et le maintien des procédures d'assurance de la qualité
• Participer aux enquêtes et vérifications commerciales.
• Appuyer les activités de développement des fournisseurs pour renforcer la performance et la conformité des fournisseurs.
• Appuyer la gestion et l'exécution du programme de non-conformité et d'action corrective.
• Soutenir, coopérer et participer activement au système de gestion de l'ESS en suivant toutes les politiques et procédures en matière de sécurité, de santé et d'environnement.
• Aider à l'examen, à l'interprétation et à la mise en oeuvre des procédures Sulzer.
• Adhérez à toutes les politiques, procédures et normes de rendement de l'entreprise et du ministère.
• Exécuter des tâches supplémentaires pour répondre aux besoins du Ministère et de l'organisation. QUALIFICATIONS ET COMPÉTENCES :
• Fortes compétences en communication écrite et verbale, solides capacités organisationnelles et un engagement démontré en matière d'intégrité et de conduite éthique.
• Compétence en applications Microsoft Office et systèmes SAP.
• Capacité d'utiliser des équipements de mesure et d'essai de base, y compris des micromètres, des coulisses et des outils similaires.
• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter les procédures et les spécifications; cerner les problèmes; recueillir et analyser les données; et tirer des conclusions solides et factuelles.

• Compréhension de base des méthodes NDE telles que UT, PT, MT, VT et RT (préféré).
